title: Inventory Control Specialist
description:
Please note that we are not currently accepting resumes or additional support from talent agencies or third-party sources. Any resumes received from these sources will be considered unsolicited. We value integrity and clear communication with our partners, and appreciate your understanding in this matter.


The role, at a glance:

As an Inventory Control Specialist I, you will support inventory accuracy through daily cycle counts, minor adjustments, and collaboration with other departments. This entry-level role is essential to maintaining the integrity of our inventory systems. This position is performed on-site during Monday–Friday, 8-hour day shifts.


How you’ll contribute:

  • Perform daily cycle counts and report discrepancies
  • Make minor inventory adjustments as needed
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing to resolve inventory accuracy issues
  • Maintain alignment between the ERP system and other software systems such as Cogiscan and Kardex
  • Participate in annual inventory audits and continuous improvement efforts
  • Assist in the disposal of obsolete or excess inventory
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor

A successful candidate should have:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in inventory control, material handling, or warehousing
  • Strong hands-on experience with warehouse bin/location mapping and location management, including establishing and maintaining location structures, auditing physical-to-system location accuracy, resolving misplaced inventory, and improving overall bin integrity
  • Demonstrated understanding of warehouse slotting and material organization principles, with the ability to maintain sustainable location discipline as inventory and production requirements change
  • Forklift certification required: with demonstrated experience safely operating powered industrial equipment in a warehouse environment. Must be comfortable using forklifts to access, move, organize, and verify inventory throughout assigned storage areas
  • Strong math skills, including basic algebra
  • Basic understanding of inventory management, cycle counting, and part numbering
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint)
  • Effective communication and organizational skills in English
  • Ability to work collaboratively and handle challenging situations
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic work environment
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality

What we offer:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 3 weeks annual PTO and 9 paid holidays
  • 401(k) + matching
  • Employer-paid base life insurance, short, and long-term disability
  • Health savings accounts (with Biamp contribution) and flexible spending accounts
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Charitable donation matching
  • Discretionary company achievement bonus
  • Referral bonuses

Who is Biamp?

We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space.

As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences.


About our company:

At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

title: Director, Grid Technology
description:
Please Note: If you are a current Hydro Ottawa employee with access to Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application.

At Hydro Ottawa, we empower the lives of the people in the communities we serve.

As the electricity distributor to the Nation’s Capital, our work powers the essential activities that make up our lives - at home, at work and at play. And as Ontario’s largest municipally-owned producer of green power, we are leading the way to a greener tomorrow.

We are seeking a Director, Grid Technology, a change champion and innovative leader ready to embrace the opportunity to guide and mentor others, and enable them to do their best work. And in doing so, to leave a legacy.

Are you ready to make a difference in our community?

JOB SUMMARY

The Director, Grid Technology is responsible for leading the strategic direction, innovation, and operations of Hydro Ottawa’s Grid Technology portfolio. This includes oversight of Smart Grid Technology strategy, Grid Operations Technology systems (SCADA, OMS, GIS, ADMS, P-Tech, Telecom), and the planning and execution of grid modernization projects. The Director, Grid Technology ensures seamless integration between grid technologies and IT systems, enables operational resilience, and drives innovation aligned with corporate priorities, regulatory requirements, and the evolving energy landscape.

The Director, Grid Technology leads a multi-disciplinary team of managers, engineers, technologists, and specialists, and collaborates closely with internal business units and external partners to deliver reliable, secure, and future-ready grid technology services.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and lead Hydro Ottawa’s Grid Technology strategy, including Smart Grid innovation, grid automation, and the integration of emerging technologies ( AI, EV, DERs, AR/VR).

  • Align the Grid Technology strategy with corporate objectives, regulatory frameworks, and the broader energy transition roadmap.

  • Oversee the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle planning of mission-critical Grid Technology systems such as SCADA, OMS, GIS, P-Tech, ADMS, PI, and Telecommunications.

  • Champion continuous improvement and innovation in grid operations, system integration, and technology enablement.

  • Direct the planning and execution of complex grid modernization projects, including business case development, risk management, vendor selection, budgeting, and implementation oversight.

  • Lead project governance and performance management to deliver measurable outcomes and value from grid technology initiatives.

  • Partner with IT and Cybersecurity teams to safeguard the security, compliance, and resilience of grid technology systems.

  • Oversee the development and execution of disaster recovery plans and business continuity strategies for operational technologies.

  • Support System Control and field operations during grid emergencies and restoration efforts by deploying appropriate technologies and procedures.

  • Participate in emergency response planning and serve as a leader during major incidents.

  • Build and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and technical specialists through strong leadership, mentorship, and succession planning.

  • Maintain oversight of workforce planning, training, and compliance with health, safety, and regulatory standards.

  • Manage strategic vendor relationships and contract performance to deliver value and support long-term technology goals.

  • Foster collaboration across Distribution Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, and IT to enable integrated planning and delivery.

  • Represent Hydro Ottawa in external forums, industry working groups, and regulatory engagements on grid modernization and innovation.

  • Monitor and evaluate emerging trends, technologies, and regulatory shifts to inform decision-making and strategic positioning.

  • Develop, manage, and report on capital and operating budgets for the Grid Technology portfolio.

  • Lead effective resource planning and investment stewardship to maximize operational efficiency and strategic impact.

  • Perform other related duties as required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering

  • Minimum 10’ years of progressive experience in electrical utility operations, grid technology, or operational technology roles, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity.

  • Demonstrated expertise in managing and integrating complex systems such as SCADA, OMS, GIS, ADMS, and related telecom infrastructure.

  • Proven leadership in large-scale grid modernization, operational technology transformation, or Smart Grid programs.

  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, telecommunications, and IT/OT integration within a utility or critical infrastructure environment.

  • Master’s degree or advanced training in Technology Management or related disciplines considered an asset.

  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) licensed or able to be licensed in the Province of Ontario considered an asset.

  • Demonstrated outstanding leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

  • Strong computer skills; proficient in the use of office productivity and collaboration tools, preferably Google Workspace.

  • English essential, both oral and written; Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset.

This is a management group opportunity and salary will be commensurate with qualifications.

Hydro Ottawa offers a Hybrid Work Model. Hybrid work is position specific, details of the hybrid model will be discussed with successful candidates.

Hydro Ottawa may use artificial intelligence (“AI”) during the recruitment process to aid in the screening and selection of candidates.

Location:

Ottawa, ON

$128,808.26

$178,153.00

December 13, 2026

We are also committed to preventing and removing barriers to employment for people with disabilities, and we invite you to inform us should you have any accessibility or accommodation needs.

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada.

title: Senior Strategic Initiatives Manager, Brand Expedia
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Strategic Initiatives Manager, Brand Expedia

Introduction to the team

Expedia Group’s consumer business has three flagship brands:

  • Expedia® is the one-stop shop for travel, with a mission of helping travelers get the most out of every trip they take by providing everything they need all in one place, and feel supported every step of the way.
  • Hotels.com® is the hotels expert that is all about giving travelers more of what they want — whether that’s instant savings, flexible options, or rewards they can actually use.
  • Vrbo® is the trusted vacation rental brand perfecting stays before they happen by helping travelers find their perfect fit, ensuring quality homes and hosts, and providing trusted support.

These teams set the strategic vision, operating plans, and investment priorities to create compelling and distinct traveler value and drive business growth. The team is responsible for effectively partnering with cross-functional teams in Marketing, Product, Technology, Supply, Advertising, Servicing, and Corporate Functions to deliver the best traveler and business outcomes.

About the role

Brand Expedia is seeking a Senior Strategic Initiatives Manager to drive the next chapter of growth and customer experience for our Hotels & Vacation Rentals business. You will own the strategy and P&L agenda for priority lodging initiatives, shaping how millions of travelers discover, book, and experience stays on Expedia.

Sitting at the intersection of growth strategy, customer lifecycle, and traveler experience this role is highly cross‑functional. You will partner closely with Marketing, Product, Supply, Servicing, Analytics, and Finance to identify the biggest opportunities, build the roadmap, and lead end‑to‑end execution from idea to scaled impact.

This is a high‑visibility role with regular exposure to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence the long‑term direction of Expedia’s lodging marketplace.

In this role, you will

  • Set the strategic agenda for Expedia Lodging (Hotels & Vacation Rentals): define the ambition, key bets, and multi‑year roadmap that deliver profitable growth and a differentiated traveler experience.
  • Own a portfolio of high‑impact strategic initiatives across the traveler lifecycle focusing on step‑change improvements in conversion, repeat rate, customer satisfaction, and market share
  • Lead cross‑functional programs end‑to‑end: frame the problem, size the opportunity, align stakeholders, stand up workstreams, and ensure on‑time, high‑quality execution across Marketing, Product, Supply, Servicing, Legal, and Finance.
  • Use data to drive decisions and understand customer needs: partner with Analytics and Data Science to build business cases, design A/B tests, measure impact, and continuously refine the strategy based on performance and customer insights.
  • Optimize commercial and operational levers across pricing, promotions, merchandising, incentives, and service design to balance growth, margin, and customer experience, in order to ensure successful execution towards Expedia’s annual plan
  • Shape the traveler and partner experience: identify friction points across the end‑to‑end journey (search to post‑trip), prioritize fixes and enhancements, and work with Product and Operations to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Drive change and organizational alignment: create clear narratives, materials, and playbooks that help teams understand the strategy, adopt new ways of working, and execute consistently across markets.
  • Collaborate with regional and local market teams to ensure strategies and initiatives are localized, executable on the ground, and responsive to competitive dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master’s degree.
  • Proven experience in strategy, marketplace / retail e‑commerce, advertising, or management consulting, including ownership of commercial outcomes.
  • Strong problem‑solving abilities with a demonstrated commitment to test‑and‑learn approaches and data‑driven decision‑making.
  • Experience working closely with Product, Marketing, Servicing, and Sales/Commercial teams; able to translate strategy into clear requirements and operational changes.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization and drive alignment across diverse teams.
  • Ability to craft compelling, insight‑driven narratives using data and communicate them clearly to a wide audience.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, with demonstrated ability to scope, plan, and deliver strategic projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Developing subject‑matter expertise in key business topics, with the ability to translate insights into actionable plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as a trusted advisor to leaders and cross‑functional partners on strategy, operational improvements, or business transformation.
  • Expertise conducting advanced data analyses, including building robust models and analytical frameworks to inform decisions.
  • Strong understanding of industry trends, performance metrics, and competitive landscapes.
  • Demonstrated ability to design new data‑collection methodologies and synthesize insights from diverse sources.
  • Proven ability to anticipate business needs, understand organizational dependencies, and navigate complex project environments.
  • Experience assessing financial impacts of change initiatives and supporting strategic investment decisions.
The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.


Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.


Benefits and perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. title: Sr Manager - Supplier Management & Analysis
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a high-caliber, transformative leader to join our organization as the Senior Manager of Strategic Supplier Management & Analysis. This critical in-house role bridges the gap between top-tier management consulting and enterprise execution.


Leveraging your background in supply chain continuous improvement and operational excellence, you will own the architectural design, deployment, and governance of our end-to-end global supply chain optimization roadmap. You will partner directly with executive stakeholders to transition our strategic sourcing, logistics, and supplier management functions from transactional operations into a world-class, digitally enabled competitive advantage.


Key Responsibilities


Capacity, Delivery & Data Management

  • Operational Diagnostics: Conduct comprehensive, consultant-grade operations maturity assessments across global strategic sourcing, contract management, inventory planning, and distribution frameworks.
  • Spend & Process Analytics: Leverage data-driven methodologies to dissect current category management strategies, identify direct/indirect leakage, and isolate operational bottlenecks.
  • Business Case Architecture: Synthesize diagnostic findings into high-impact business cases, calculating complex total cost of ownership (TCO), ROI, and net-present-value (NPV) metrics for executive approval.
  • Develop and implement systems to inform SIOP process with supplier capacity and lead time to support operation planning.


Supplier Performance Management

  • Implement supplier performance metrics and measurement to inform continuous improvement and suppler performance management.
  • Hire and lead two direct reports, and coordinate among other strategic directors and operational supply chain teams in manufacturing locations to lead data management and supplier performance management functions.


Strategy Deployment & Lean Transformation

  • Continuous Improvement Frameworks: Establish and institutionalize an enterprise-wide CI process for implementing Category and Supplier Strategies, Strategic Sourcing and Supply Chain execution. Leverage tools (e.g., Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Kanban, Root Cause Analysis) to drive data and process driven improvement projects with ROI delivery.
  • Strategic Sourcing Excellence: Redesign sourcing processes to embed advanced supplier relationship management (SRM), risk mitigation, and predictive cost-modeling into the organizational DNA.
  • Process Standardization: Author and deploy standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and standardized negotiation strategies across a decentralized organizational footprint.


Change Management & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Consultative Influence: Operate as the internal partner of choice, seamlessly navigating matrixed organizations to align corporate strategy with local plant or regional supply chain execution.
  • Capability Building: Architect and facilitate structured capability-building programs, coaching internal sourcing teams, category managers, and supply planners in operational excellence practices.
  • Culture Transformation: Shift organizational behavior from reactive firefighting to a proactive culture of perpetual efficiency and value creation.


Digital Transformation & Analytics Governance

  • Systems Optimization: Partner with IT and Finance to maximize return on enterprise investments (e.g., ERP, TMS, WMS, and e-Sourcing suites).
  • KPI Architecture: Design, implement, and govern global executive-level supply chain dashboards, managing critical metrics (e.g., Perfect Order Rate, Supplier OTIF, Spend Under Management, Category Cost Savings).

Preferred Background & Qualifications


Experience

  • This person will be creating a new organization that will be responsible for the following tasks and will need to start as a hand-on contributor that will be able to build and lead their own team.
  • Leadership: This is a role for a hands-on leader, team builder, consensus builder and leader of change.
  • Supply Chain Transformation Management: Experience project managing change and continuous improvement projects in a manufacturing company within the strategic supply chain organization.
  • Management Consulting Foundation: Experience working in supply chain continuous improvement either alongside or within a premier management consulting firm or boutique supply chain advisory outfit, specifically executing supply chain, operational excellence, or strategic sourcing transformations. We are looking for this person to build this internal know-how and CI culture.
  • Corporate Transferability: Combined or foundational exposure to in-house operational environments (Manufacturing, CPG, Energy, or Automotive) is highly valued.
  • Proven Impact: A documented track record of delivering substantial annualized margin expansions, working capital improvements, structural lead-time reductions and synergistic sourcing across multiple manufacturing locations in US and Mexico.


Education & Certifications

  • Academic Baseline: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Operations Research, Business Administration, or a highly quantitative discipline. An MBA or advanced MS degree is strongly preferred.
  • Technical Credentials: Highly value Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB) certification or equivalent formal continuous improvement training.
  • Professional Accreditations: APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or ISM (CPM, CPSM) certifications are considered a significant advantage.


Competencies & Skillsets

  • Advanced Problem Solving: Mastery of structured problem-solving frameworks (e.g., MECE structuring, hypothesis-driven analytics).
  • Data Synthesis: Advanced proficiency in data-driven tools and dashboard development for KPI’s (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI) and complex financial modeling.
  • Communication Mastery: Executive presence with the ability to distill highly technical operational concepts into razor-sharp, compelling presentations for C-suite alignment.



Why Will You Love Working Here?

• A collaborative culture.

• Opportunities to make a real impact as we grow.

• Competitive pay, great benefits, and a great team.

• Celebrations, volunteer days, and moments that make work more than just “work”!

Are You Ready to Join the Team?

title: Project Manager - Research & Strategy

title: Senior Director, Talent Strategy Partner
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Director - Talent Strategy Partner


Introduction to the team:

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.


As part of Expedia Group's Talent team, the Senior Director, Talent Strategy Partner is a senior expert that shapes and delivers the talent and organization agenda for our divisions. You operate comfortably at both the strategic and tactical levels, pairing big-picture thinking about talent with a hands-on approach to analysis and execution.


You bring a strong foundation in talent management and organizational effectiveness, coupled with a hypothesis-driven, evidence-based approach to understanding talent outcomes, leadership effectiveness, organizational health, and workforce capability development.


You put the traveler first by ensuring we have the leadership, capabilities, talent strategy, and organizational design to build world-class travel experiences at scale.


In this role, you will:

Talent Strategy Delivery

  • Partner with HRBP Leaders to co create divisional talent agendas (e.g., capability building, leadership pipelines, mobility and development strategies) that drive near term priorities and longer term strategic plans.
  • Apply Industrial/Organizational Psychology principles and evidence-based talent practices to improve leadership assessment, succession planning, capability development, promotion effectiveness, and talent outcomes across the organization.
  • Assess global talent and learning needs to define critical capability gaps; Translate these insights into an integrated talent strategy and roadmap that leverages data-driven health metrics to scale organizational performance.
  • Lead end to end succession planning and talent reviews for key leadership and critical roles, in partnership with HRBP Leaders and divisional leadership teams. Partnering with Talent Acquisition on VP+ executive pipelines.
  • Design and evaluate talent interventions using robust assessment, validation, and measurement approaches to ensure programs drive meaningful business and talent outcomes.
  • Use talent and organizational health metrics to identify strengths, risks, and pipeline gaps, turning insights into concrete actions (development, moves, hiring, coaching).
  • Coach leaders and HRBPs on consistent talent identification and assessment practices, ensuring our processes are equitable and support diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Organization Design Consulting

  • Influence leaders to arrive at efficient, scalable, strategy-aligned org structures by leveraging org design expertise and best practices, including diagnostics, scenario design, options analysis.
  • Ensure org design aligns with enterprise frameworks and strategies, including headcount plans, financial guardrails, and enterprise org and talent standards (e.g., leveling guidelines).

Data Insights & Governance

  • Use talent and organizational health metrics (e.g., performance, succession, promotion, attrition, engagement) and rigorous analytical methodologies to generate insights, identify causal drivers, and inform talent and organizational decisions at the divisional and enterprise level.
  • Partner closely with People Analytics to design, execute, and interpret research studies, pilot programs, experimentation, and statistical analyses that measure the effectiveness of talent and leadership initiatives.
  • Leverage experimentation and evidence-based practices, including hypothesis testing and program evaluation, to continuously improve talent strategies and organizational outcomes.
  • Track and communicate progress against talent and succession outcomes (bench strength, diversity outcomes, critical role coverage, internal mobility) and refine strategies based on these insights.
  • Role model an ownership mindset by treating divisional talent and org health as your business – focusing on long term value, not just the current cycle.

Enterprise Talent Champion

  • Lead readiness and change management to ensure talent products are flawlessly launched and deeply embedded for HRBPs, leaders, and employees.
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert (SME) for HRBPs and leaders on global talent products (e.g., EG Performance Management products), championing their implementation to drive the right results.
  • Influence enterprise talent strategies and product roadmaps by leveraging deep insight about HRBPs’, leaders’, and employees’ needs to ensure simple, scalable, and well understood products, processes, and playbooks.
  • ollaborate across the People Team and Expedia Group
  • Work closely with Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Learning, Total Rewards, People Tech, People Analytics and HRBPs to bring an integrated People perspective to leaders while advancing research-informed and evidence-based talent practices across the enterprise.
  • Succeed together by sharing best practices, case studies and tools with HRBPs and Talent colleagues to raise the bar on talent, org design, and change capabilities across EG.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • 14+ years' experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development/Effectiveness, HR Business Partnering, or Industrial/Organizational Psychology-focused talent and organizational consulting roles.
  • Proven experience partnering with C-suite and senior leaders in complex, global, matrixed organizations, operating as a high influence individual contributor who leads through expertise and relationships rather than direct authority.
  • Demonstrated experience applying Industrial/Organizational Psychology, behavioral science, organizational research, assessment science, workforce analytics, or related methodologies to solve talent and organizational challenges.
  • Demonstrated impact shaping global talent and org strategies with significant scope and complexity (e.g., multiple regions, functions/divisions, or large-scale transformations).
  • Talent management expertise: deep understanding of performance, potential, readiness, and succession frameworks; able to coach leaders and HRBPs in using them effectively.
  • Org design & change management: able to diagnose organizational issues, design and evaluate alternative structures, and create pragmatic change and transition plans that leaders can execute.
  • Data fluency and research rigor: able to interpret people and business data, identify patterns and risks, apply research methodologies, evaluate talent interventions, tell a clear story, and use insights to guide decisions and measure impact.
  • Relationship building & collaboration: trusted partner to HRBPs and leaders; actively connects across Talent, Org Effectiveness, Learning and other COEs to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Master's degree preferred (Bachelor's degree required) in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD preferred) in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, or a related discipline strongly preferred. Experience conducting organizational research, program evaluation, talent assessment validation, workforce analytics, or experimental design is highly valued. Professional certifications in Assessments (e.g., Hogan, Insights), OD, Change Management, or Coaching (e.g., ICF ACC) are also a plus.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $269,000.00 to $376,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $430,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.


Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.


Benefits and perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Data Analytics & Engineering Tech Lead - IoT
description:
Data Analytics & Engineering Tech Lead - IoT

Function:Digital & Technology

Digital & Technology Team (D&T) is an integral division of HEINEKEN Business Services Poland (HBSP). We are committed to making Heineken the most connected brewery. That includes digitalizing and integrating our processes, ensuring best-in-class technology, and embedding a data-driven culture. By joining us you will work in one of the most dynamic and innovative teams and have a direct impact on building the future of Heineken!
Would you like to meet the Team, see our office and much more? Visit our website: Heineken ( heineken-dt.pl )

We are looking for a Data Analytics & Engineering Tech Lead to own the technical direction, production readiness, and capability leadership for the Data Engineering, BI Development, and Data Science chapter supporting the Connected Brewery data product ecosystem.

The role is accountable for setting and governing data and analytics standards, reusable architecture patterns, delivery methods, and production-readiness expectations across a multi‑OpCo, multi‑brewery, multi‑use‑case ecosystem. Connected Brewery should be treated as a scalable data product landscape, not as a single delivery stream.

The Tech Lead partners with the Product Owner and leads alignment across squad leads, technical leads, platform teams, breweries, OpCos, and global analytics stakeholders to ensure that delivery decisions support both immediate programme outcomes and reusable enterprise capability.

The role is accountable for defining, managing, and executing the short-, medium-, and long‑term technical roadmap of the chapter. This includes capability planning, technical risk management, architecture pattern approval, dependency resolution, and the creation of reusable data product patterns that can scale beyond individual use cases or sites.

The role ensures that data pipelines, BI outputs, semantic‑layer inputs, analytical solutions, and machine‑learning‑ready datasets are scalable, reusable, reliable, observable, secure, supportable, and designed for adoption across multiple breweries and OpCos.

The Tech Lead enables squads to operate effectively within their delivery structures while owning cross‑squad standards, architecture patterns, data product governance, production‑readiness criteria, and downstream consumption requirements.

The role is centred on building durable data foundations and reusable analytics capabilities across extraction, transformation, storage, quality assurance, integration, deployment, operational support, stakeholder engagement, and capability building across data professionals.

Your responsibilities would include:

Chapter Leadership and People Management:

  • leading and line-managing approximately 4–10 Data Engineers, BI Developers, and Data Scientists, including work allocation, coaching, performance management, development planning, and capacity planning
  • ownership of the chapter operating model, capability plan, skill matrix, succession risks, and hiring needs for the Connected Brewery data and analytics capability
  • setting technical expectations for chapter members and ensure consistent engineering, BI, analytics, documentation, and production-support practices
  • developing the technical career growth of chapter members through mentoring, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability building
  • governing vendor and contractor contribution where applicable, ensuring external delivery capacity follows chapter standards and contributes to reusable assets
  • definition and governance of the reusable data product patterns, architecture principles, semantic‑layer inputs, BI delivery standards, and analytical delivery methods across breweries, OpCos, and use cases
  • approving key architecture patterns and manage technical trade‑offs between tactical squad delivery, long‑term scalability, operational supportability, and platform direction
  • leading cross‑squad dependency management, delivery prioritisation, technical risk resolution, and alignment across squads, platform teams, breweries, and OpCos
  • ensuring that Connected Brewery evolves as a scalable data product ecosystem with reusable methods, components, templates, and standards that can be adopted beyond individual sites.Scalable Data and Analytics Delivery
  • driving the delivery of scalable data pipelines, curated datasets, semantic‑layer inputs, BI outputs, advanced analytics outputs, and machine‑learning‑ready data assets
  • setting standards for reusable, trusted, observable, supportable, secure, and cost‑conscious data products and pipelines
  • ensuring data and analytics delivery is designed for repeated adoption across multiple use cases, breweries, countries, and OpCos
  • owning alignment between AWS‑based data engineering patterns and Azure‑based semantic‑layer, BI, and downstream analytics consumption requirements
  • reducing duplication across reports, datasets, metric definitions, transformation logic, and squad‑specific implementations by enforcing common reusable patterns
  • accountability for data quality, lineage, observability, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production-readiness standards across data products and pipelines
  • ensuring technical decisions, dependencies, transformation logic, design assumptions, support models, and downstream impacts are documented and governed
  • accountability for planning and influencing the chapter’s technical resource envelope, vendor and contractor contribution, tooling decisions, cloud consumption, and run‑cost optimisation within agreed programme and platform budgets. Contributes to annual and quarterly planning for delivery capacity, platform consumption, support needs, and scale/run investment required to productise Connected Brewery capabilities across breweries and OpCos.

You are a good candidate if you have:

Qualifications:

  • minimum 10 years of experience across Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Science Enablement, or similar data and analytics roles
  • at least 3 years of technical leadership experience in a complex data, analytics, BI, AI/ML, or platform delivery environment
  • proven experience leading, line-managing, or formally coordinating mixed technical teams, including performance management, coaching, capability planning, and work allocation
  • experience defining standards, reusable methods, architecture patterns, governance practices, and production‑readiness expectations across multiple teams, sites, markets, or business units
  • experience managing delivery across multiple stakeholders, squads, technical disciplines, and enterprise platforms.

Experience / Skills:

  • working across multiple environments such as development, test, staging, and production
  • designing pipelines that support multiple consumers and use cases
  • understanding how to build scalable and reusable data processing patterns
  • understanding how curated datasets are consumed by BI and analytics teams
  • supporting BI Developers in building reliable reporting and semantic‑layer outputs
  • supporting the creation of trusted datasets for BI, dashboarding, and advanced analytics
  • helping reduce duplication across reports, datasets, and squad‑specific logic
  • ensuring that reporting and analytics requirements are considered when designing upstream data pipelines
  • supporting alignment between operational reporting, historical reporting, and advanced analytics use cases
  • unit and integration testing for data pipeline, with data lineage and traceability
  • pipeline observability and operational monitoring
  • reconciliation between source and target datasets
  • handling pipeline failures, retries, and support processes
  • ensuring transformation logic and data dependencies are documented
  • supporting production readiness and handover of data products
  • ensuring reporting and analytical outputs are based on trusted and well‑understood data.

You are a perfect match if you also have:

  • AWS Step Functions
  • EventBridge or event‑driven data processing
  • Lambda‑based orchestration or lightweight integration patterns
  • Iceberg, Delta, or similar table formats
  • understanding of Azure data platform concepts
  • working with Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric, or similar services
  • supporting BI and analytics teams with curated, trusted, and model‑ready datasets
  • understanding how data needs to be structured for Power BI or advanced analytics use cases
  • helping align AWS data preparation with Azure‑based consumption patterns
  • understanding the hand‑off between data engineering outputs and semantic‑layer modelling
  • Power BI exposure
  • experience supporting advanced analytics teams
  • experience with operational dashboards or Grafana
  • experience with KPI and metric standardisation across multiple sites or OpCos.

What we’re looking for...

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Join a Global Logistics Leader: Logistics Coordinator • Job Type: Permanent Full-Time • Location: 5290 Orbitor Dr, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Z5 (directly across from Pearson International Airport). • Work Hours and schedule: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, with occasional overtime on the last day of the month or as necessary. 4 days in office (Monday to Thursday), 1 day remote (Friday) Who We Are Wallenius Wilhelmsen (WW) is a global leader in shipping and logistics, with over 155 years of experience and almost 10,000 employees across 29 countries. While this role is based in Mississauga, it supports national operations, including our Vancouver vehicle processing terminal, employing over 300 union and exempt staff. As the sole Auto Terminals operator of the Port of Vancouver, located on Annacis Island, we handle, accessorize, and distribute nearly 100% of all Asian-manufactured vehicle imports for the Canadian market. We serve more than a dozen of the world’s top auto manufacturers, including Nissan, Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Subaru, and more. This team, based out of the Nissan head office in Mississauga, is focused on providing end-to-end logistics for our biggest automotive client globally, Nissan. Our operations in Mississauga include managing the flow from Nissan plants and the Vancouver port, where WW is involved with shipping outbound through rail, and trucking to dealers. Why Join Wallenius Wilhelmsen? • Competitive Salary and Annual Bonus: The salary range for this position is $55,000 - $65,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications. • Company-Paid RRSP Contributions: We invest in your future with RRSP contributions that do not require matching. • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Enjoy 100% company-paid extended health benefits, covering medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. • Career Growth and Job Security: We offer excellent opportunities for advancement in a global organization with strong roots in Canada as the sole operator of the Port of Vancouver’s Auto Processing Terminals and be part of a global leader in logistics and supply chain management, where your work helps manage and distribute vehicles for world-renowned auto manufacturers like Nissan and Infiniti. • Hybrid Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working on Fridays remotely, giving you a better work-life balance. • Inclusive and Diverse Work Environment: We are proud of our diverse team, which represents various ethnic backgrounds and languages, fostering a true sense of belonging. • Collaborative and Fun Culture: At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, we believe in a positive work-life balance. This includes WW team outings like Christmas dinners, and occasionally events such as Raptors or Maple Leaf games. We also have lunch and dinner events with Nissan. About the Role In this Logistics Coordinator role, you will manage the release and delivery of NCI (Nissan and Infiniti) vehicles, ensuring smooth inventory flow and optimizing transportation costs. You’ll be the primary point of contact for external suppliers, building daily ad hoc reports on MS Excel, navigating internal systems and using data to drive efficiency across our logistics operations. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with teams across Canada, U. S, and Mexico, and enhancing your logistics expertise. Your key responsibilities will include: • Inventory & Product Flow Management: • Manage daily coordination with the plant, compounds, rail, and trucking companies to monitor the performance and inventory management of NCI vehicles. • Collect, analyze, and reconcile data from NCI reports, WITS, and external sources to document daily inventories, truck-away capacity, and rail pipelines across Canada. • Monitor released units to ensure product flow aligns with expectations, maintaining accurate system records and ensuring data is reflected correctly in both NCI and WW systems. • Conduct daily inventory sweeps, reconcile discrepancies, and correct data anomalies. • Investigate system anomalies and resolve potential issues affecting product flow and payment processing. • Customer Service & Supplier Coordination: • Interface daily with external suppliers regarding NCI’s vehicle releases, estimated delivery times, re-routes, priority moves, and other logistics requests, ensuring delivery meets or exceeds contracted parameters. • Communicate with NCI to maintain the highest standards of customer satisfaction, addressing vehicle distribution and sales-related inquiries promptly and accurately. • Review and respond to daily logistics requests, ensuring data integrity before involving external suppliers. • Special Event & Request Management: • Coordinate and implement NCI’s Special Requisition requests for events such as National Auto Shows, Ride & Drives, Mall Tours, and press or fleet customer events. This includes importing prototype units from Japan, the U. S., or Mexico. • Arrange special requests, such as dealer pickups at compounds, and manage the disposition of damaged vehicles. • Obtain and negotiate carrier rate quotes to ensure cost-effective transportation to and from events • Liaise with supply chain partners and specialized carriers to meet specific event timelines, including move-in and move-out schedules. • Financial & Payment Processing: • Prepare, audit, and verify manual freight invoices from carriers, ensuring accurate G/L and cost-center coding, and submit them to NCI finance for payment processing. • Follow up on unpaid or unprocessed payment requests to ensure timely carrier payment. • Process Improvement & Collaboration: • Regularly review and improve logistics processes to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. • Collaborate with team members to brainstorm and develop the best logistics solutions for more complex challenges. • Other Duties: • Perform other duties as assigned. This Role Is a Great Fit If You Have: • Education: A university degree or equivalent experience is preferred. • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced expertise in Excel, including building and troubleshooting complex formulas. • Analytical & Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and analytical abilities. Experience with forecasting and cost modelling is highly desirable. • Communication & Customer Service: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong customer service orientation. • Logistics Knowledge: Previous experience or comprehensive knowledge of logistics and supply chain management is preferred. • Planning & Problem-Solving: Strong planning, organizational, and critical thinking skills that support carrier performance and help achieve company objectives. • Time Management: Ability to manage time efficiently and perform tasks in a timely manner, while meeting deadlines. • Autonomy & Flexibility: Well-organized and capable of working independently, while being flexible and comfortable in a dynamic work environment. • Proactive Approach: A self-starter who takes a proactive approach to problem-solving rather than a reactive one. • Collaboration & Communication: Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with various departments within WWL VSA and Nissan Canada. • Customer Service Expertise: Competent in handling customer inquiries related to operational and logistics matters. • Troubleshooting & Decision-Making: Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills. • Operational Awareness: Practical understanding of operational constraints, including time and resources, and the ability to act accordingly. • Team Player: A strong team player with a collaborative mindset. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, we encourage you to apply online today! We look forward to reviewing your application.

Who We Are


At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, you'll join a global leader in shipping and logistics with more than 9,000 colleagues across 28 countries. Together, we help move vehicles, equipment, and goods around the world through innovative and sustainable solutions. Our ambition is to lead the way in transforming shipping and logistics.


Our success is built on our people. Rooted in a strong safety culture and guided by our values – We Care, We Challenge, We Commit – we create an environment where people can grow, contribute, and perform at their best. As a global company listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange, we offer international opportunities within a collaborative and values-driven culture.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities and an Inclusive Workplace

At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, our people are fundamental to our success. We believe in the power of bringing people together and value the unique experiences, skills, and perspectives every individual brings. These differences strengthen our ability to support our customers, drive innovation, and succeed as a global organisation. By fostering an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute, we create better outcomes for our people, our customers, and our business.

title: Group Bayport - Senior Manager/Assistant General Manager - Logistics

Designation: Senior Manager/Assistant General Manager - Logistics

Location: Gandhinagar

About the Role:

This role owns end-to-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation - from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery - while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run high-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast-scaling, compliance-intensive environment.

Key Responsibilities:

- International Carrier & Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners - rate negotiation, annual contracts, service-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.

- Inbound & Outbound Logistics: Own inbound raw material import logistics with a focus on cost and lead-time reduction, alongside full ownership of outbound sea and air shipments across B2B, B2C, and marketplace channels.

- SEZ & Trade Compliance: Ensure disciplined, audit-ready execution of shipping bill filing, customs documentation, and SEZ regulatory requirements, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and Importer of Record (IOR) procedures across key markets (US, Canada, UK, Australia, EU, China).

- 3PL Vendor Bill Audit & Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor - this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.

- End-to-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in-transit visibility, destination customs, last-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).

- Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund & reship, and Atlanta linked shipping - building capability and accountability at every level.

- Performance & MIS Reporting: Own a KPI-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence - cycle time by stage, on-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost-shipment tracking, and POD closure - with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics.

- Cost & Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.

- Business Expansion & Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.

- Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.

- Exception & Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high-impact exceptions - customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes - ensuring timely closure and clear communication.

- Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in-house.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 - 12 Months):

- A fully visible, stage-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle - inbound through final delivery, not just packing-to-carrier-handover.

- A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance.

- Measurable improvement in on-time pickup and on-time delivery percentages across all three carriers.

- A formalized, audit-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times.

- A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines.

- A stable, accountable, well-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence.

Required Experience:

- 10 - 15 years in international logistics/parcel-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers.

- Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred - this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier-heavy, SLA-driven model.

- Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded-warehouse environments.

- Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance.

- Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands-on, floor present leadership style.

- Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus.

- Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process-improvement certification is an advantage.

Key Competencies:

- Operational and financial rigor under time-sensitive, SLA-driven conditions.

- Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets.

- Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them.

- Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-scaling, still-formalizing process environment - able to build structure, not just follow it.

title: Shipping & Receiving Associate

SUMMARY OF POSITION

  • Carefully and accurately maintains shipping records for requested categories including goods returned, dunnage, and returnable pallets.

  • Receive, inspect, and verify incoming shipments against purchase orders and packing slips.
  • Prepare and package outgoing shipments, ensuring accuracy and proper labeling
  • Coordinate with carriers and schedule pickups/deliveries
  • Load and unload trucks using appropriate equipment (forklift, pallet jack, etc.)
  • Maintain accurate records of all shipments and inventory transactions
  • Organize and store materials in designated warehouse locations
  • Perform regular inventory counts and assist with cycle counts
  • Identify and report damaged or missing items
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and shipping regulations
  • Communicate with internal teams (purchasing, production, etc.) to ensure timely material flow
  • Performs other clerical duties.

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, SKILLS AND/OR ABILITIES REQUIRED

Minimum Experience: 1-3 Years Related Experience, proficient with Microsoft Suite

Degree Preferred: High School Diploma or Equivalent

Certification(s) Required: Must be able to pass Forklift Certification (we will provide)

Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong computer skills and experience with Microsoft Suite
  • Efficient using Microsoft Excel
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively
  • Good communication and teamwork skills
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach

title: Lead Fightback Campaigner
description:
Position Title: Lead Fightback Campaigner

Position Location: Candidates are welcome to apply from across the U.S. Those that are near the Popular Democracy office in DC may be asked to work from the office one or two days/week if necessary. Applicants outside of this area may be required to travel to the Popular Democracy office occasionally.

Popular Democracy is seeking a Lead Fightback Campaigner to join our Fightback Department. This is a full-time, exempt position.

About Popular Democracy:

Popular Democracy works to promote equity, opportunity, and a dynamic democracy in partnership with innovative base-building organizations, organizing networks and alliances, and progressive unions across the country. We work with nearly 50 affiliates across 30+ states, Puerto Rico, and DC to build the strength and capacity of democratic organizations that envision and advance a pro-worker, pro-immigrant, racial and economic justice agenda. We are a rapidly-expanding, changing organization that partners with organizations across the country to build political power and win tangible victories that improve the lives of low-wage workers, immigrants, and communities of color.

About the Position:

We are seeking a Lead Fightback Campaigner (LFC) to use the crises and opportunities of the moment to vastly expand the network's base, develop leaders, move those people into action, and change the narrative in the process. This includes driving a fundraising plan to support the work, serving as an expert in relevant issue area(s), supporting the network with issue-specific requests, and building alliances with groups outside of the network. Working with affiliates, allies, and individuals to build political and community power, the LFC position organizes actions and other events to contest for power, deepening understanding and building capacity across the network.

It is expected that the Lead Fightback Campaigner will travel and attend in-person trainings, meetings, and actions with Popular Democracy affiliates and partners frequently, approximately 2x per month.

We estimate that candidates will have about 12 years of relevant experience, but our review of candidates for this role will focus on whether they can fill the needs of the position, not years of experience.

The Lead Fightback Campaigner will report to the Director of Fightback.

Primary Responsibilities:

The Lead Fightback Campaigner will:

  • Develop and sustain positive relationships with affiliate organizations, partners, policy makers, and funders, encouraging participation and support for Popular Democracy’s efforts.
  • Select targeted areas identified as key to contesting for power and identify, plan, and execute campaigns or programs to advance the Fightback narrative.
  • Work with the Organizing and Communications and Narrative teams to support affiliates in developing campaigns and base-building programs.
  • Work with internal stakeholders, allies, and partners to design and build a complex program and campaign that includes a theory of the issue with a cogent message and narrative that motivates people to action.
  • Develop and sustain relationships with elected officials and their representatives.
  • Organize regular lobby days and press conferences.
  • Develop and implement organizing strategies for Popular Democracy’s leadership development program, which includes organizing individuals directly impacted by cuts to government programs engaging their members of congress.
  • Provide strategic and tactical support for events in assigned campaigns.
  • When strategic to the advancement of Fightback goals, lead and facilitate cohort meetings for targeted groups, which may include determining the schedule of meetings, creating the agenda, evaluating planning steps on an ongoing basis, and implementing next steps.
  • Drive a fundraising plan to meet established objectives in collaboration with supervisor

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • Significant experience in organizing and grassroots campaign development.
  • Demonstrated basebuilding experience.
  • Experience in campaign and policy creation, particularly at the national level
  • Strong facilitation meeting skills.
  • Experience working in coalitions and alliances.
  • A demonstrated ability to build relationships with a broad range of people that move them into action.
  • The ability to work independently, navigate obstacles, discern priorities, and meet competing deadlines.
  • Fluency in Spanish language skills preferred, but not required;
  • Experience working with Popular Democracy affiliates.
  • A demonstrated commitment to social, racial, and economic justice and a deep understanding of challenges facing low-wage workers, immigrant communities, communities of color, disabled people, LGBTQ+ folks, and people at the intersections of the above communities.

Hiring Process:

Candidates should expect to participate in two rounds of group interviews and a job simulation exercise. Final candidates will be asked to provide references.

Salary and Benefits:

This position is included in a collective bargaining unit represented by the Washington-Baltimore News Guild. Specific employment terms are subject to a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). The salary for this category 4 position is determined by a salary calculation system that is set by the CBA and is not negotiable. The starting salary is $100,000 and can increase up to $110,000, depending on a variety of factors as described in the CBA.

We have a generous benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 15 vacation days your first year, 12 sick days per year, additional PTO, including holidays, and contributions to individuals’ 401K plans.

Popular Democracy is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and actively recruits people of color, womxn, individuals with disabilities, and members of the LGBTIQAA+ community.

title: WSH OFFICER
description:
We are looking for a Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Officer to oversee day-to-day safety for shipbuilding, ship repair, and marine fabrication work. You will work with shipyard safety teams, project managers, supervisors and subcontractors to verify that safety controls are in place before work starts and maintained throughout each shift.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct safety inspections on board vessels, in dry docks, at berths, and in fabrication workshops. Record findings and verify that corrective actions are completed.

  • Review Risk Assessments, Safe Work Procedures and Permit-to-Work documentation with supervisors. Check that permits are valid and job-site conditions match the approved controls.

  • Monitor high-risk activities, including hot work, confined space entry, lifting and rigging, work at height, scaffolding and energy isolation (LOTO).

  • Coordinate with shipyard personnel and subcontractors when multiple trades are working in the same area. Check controls such as fire watches, ventilation, barricades, and clear access and escape routes.

  • Conduct safety inductions and toolbox briefings. Intervene immediately when unsafe work is observed and escalate serious hazards to site management.

  • Investigate incidents and near misses, prepare reports and follow up on corrective actions.

  • Monitor housekeeping, waste segregation, chemical storage and spill prevention. Participate in emergency drills and maintain inspection, training and incident records.

Requirements

  • Relevant qualification in Workplace Safety and Health (WSH), Occupational Safety and Health, Engineering or a related field.

  • At least 3 years of site-based HSE experience in a shipyard, supporting shipbuilding, ship repair, marine fabrication or vessel outfitting.

  • Practical knowledge of shipyard Permit-to-Work procedures, risk assessments, and controls for hot work, confined spaces, lifting, and work at height.

  • Ability to coordinate with multiple trades and communicate safety instructions clearly to workers, supervisors and subcontractors.

  • MOM registration as a WSH Officer is an advantage.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to define and implement ABB’s cybersecurity strategy aligned with the overall strategy and business needs. Each day, you will manage cybersecurity risks that could affect the ABB brand and customer base for all ABB offerings, in a cost-effective way. About ABB's Process Control Platform (PCP)

Process Control Platform (PCP) is the technological foundation of Automation's business area, delivering world-class Distributed Control Systems (DCS). Combining proven expertise with innovation, PCP shapes the future of automation and enables industrial digital transformation. by developing safe and reliable control systems.

Its portfolio includes leading systems: ABB Ability™ System 800xA®, ABB Ability™ Symphony® Plus, Freelance and Aprol, along with safety, industrial edge and PLC automation solutions. It also covers a broad base of heritage systems, including Advant Master, MOD 300, Harmony INFI 90 and Melody. Building on this installed base and deep automation expertise, PCP is advancing the next generation of automation through Automation Extended and digital offerings including ABB Ability™ Edgenius and ABB Ability™ Field Information Manager. By expanding the traditional boundaries of automation and building a broader process automation ecosystem, PCP helps customers improve operational performance, extend system lifecycles and outrun their challenges. As a value-generating partner, PCP ensures that its portfolio remains comprehensive and competitive, supports previously released systems and evolves with market demands through close collaboration with the divisions. The organization also manages Quality and Operations and provides essential support in product training, sales enablement and marketing communications.

At its core, PCP fosters a diverse and inclusive environment where employees are empowered to innovate, grow and make a lasting impact on customers, industry and society.

title: Inspector
description:
Position Summary:

The Inspector position will perform construction inspection services on various types of construction projects to ensure project compliance with contract documents and applicable regulations/codes. Inspection projects involve various types of construction including site civil land developments, roadways, bridges, airport infrastructure, grading, asphalt/concrete paving, underground utilities, water/wastewater treatment plants, storm drainage, intersection improvements, sidewalks, multi-use pathways, traffic signals, etc. Inspection projects may include other components within the disciplines of architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and/or industrial, etc. Inspection projects may include new construction work, maintenance work, rehab work, renovation work, and/or repair work for various types of clients including municipalities, State DOTs, airports, turnpike associations, private developers, private corporations, etc.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review project plans, specifications, contract documents, approved submittals and shop drawings, geo-tech reports and any other applicable project reporting prior to start of construction to gain clear understanding of project
  • Ensure all materials and equipment being incorporated into the project have an approved submittal or shop drawing prior to being installed on project
  • Monitor and ensure that project construction activities being performed, and materials/equipment being incorporated into the project are compliant with the project plans, specifications, contract documents, approved submittals & shop drawings, geo-tech reports, and applicable regulations/codes
  • Notify the contractor and Project Engineer or Project Manager of non-conforming work
  • Prepare and maintain daily inspection reports, utilizing established reporting format, for the construction activities inspected
  • Prepare and maintain weekly inspection summary reports, utilizing established reporting formats, for the week’s construction progress on the project
  • Measure and track completed quantities and installed pay items, utilizing established tracking methods (including Excel spreadsheet templates) or creating quantity tracking methods or Excel spreadsheets as necessary. Perform computations with formulas, plot data and draw simple curves/graphs as necessary. Verifies plan quantities
  • Track and document contractor contract time through established reporting format
  • Take photographs (pre-construction, during construction, post-construction) of the project construction progress, site conditions, installed materials/equipment to create a chronological documented visual history of the project
  • Ensure onsite materials testing is scheduled, observe onsite materials testing, ensure onsite materials testing is compliant with the project specifications, and ensure material testing results/reports are distributed to the applicable project team members, as determined by the Project Engineer or Project Manager. Perform field material testing and sample collection when necessary
  • Produce redline drawings by tracking/logging redline changes on electronic set of plans
  • Review Contractor pay estimates to verify quantities match Inspector’s summary of quantities log
  • Attend construction project meetings including but not limited to pre-construction meeting, progress meetings, safety meetings, substantial/final completion walk-through meetings, other meetings as determined by the Project Engineer or Project Manager
  • Produce and maintain punch lists of remaining and/or deficient work on the project
  • Utilize an established electronic filing system and project folder tree to save and maintain all inspection project records and reports
  • Ensure that Inspection Quality Control Checks are completed on each project per the established Inspection Quality Procedures
  • Drive to assigned project sites and project related meetings daily
  • May assist other PEC Team Members in the field, while performing project-related services such surveying, geotechnical soil and materials investigations, etc.
  • Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the company’s discretion

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of methods, practices, principles and techniques of engineering disciplines (civil, architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, environmental, industrial, etc.) and field engineering services (inspection, field/lab materials testing, survey, geotechnical engineering, construction management) pertaining to construction inspection projects
  • Knowledge of city/state/federal codes, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to construction inspection projects
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) and PDF Editor (Bluebeam)
  • Proficiency in using computers, tablets, and cell phones
  • Proficiency in using construction inspection tools (measuring wheel, measuring tape, levels, etc.); Knowledge of GPS data collectors, laser levels, range finders preferred
  • Skill in developing/maintaining cooperative and professional working relationships with team members, managers, clients, public, etc.
  • Skill in performing quality control initiatives and taking prompt action for problem resolution
  • Communication (written & oral): Ability to communicate clearly and effectively; Ability to listen and understand directions, information, and ideas when presented by others; Ability to handle a variety of issues with tact, diplomacy and in a confidential manner
  • Ability to plan/organize daily work routine and to establish priorities for the completion of required work within required timeframes
  • Ability to work 50+ hours per week, including nights and weekends when necessary
  • Ability and willingness to accept occasional out-of-town projects if needed

Education and Experience:

  • Current/Valid Driver’s License required
  • KDOT inspection experience preferred
  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree or higher required
  • An A.S., B.S. or B.A. degree in an appropriate construction-related, technical, or engineering field, preferred
  • Experience in field construction inspection or demonstrated equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience in a related construction, technical, or engineering field, preferred

License and Certification:

  • The following KDOT CIT certifications are preferred: Basic Inspection (BI), Asphalt Paving Inspection (API), Concrete Paving Inspection (CPI), Structures Inspection (STR), Nuclear Gauge (NUC), American Concrete Institute Concrete Field Tester (ACI CF), and Construction Storm Water (CSW)

Work Environment:

PEC values a healthy work-life balance, and we focus on working efficiently and collaboratively to ensure quality and productive work. The work environment is business casual, friendly, respectful, and team oriented with daily peer interactions regarding work progress, client needs and project-specific technical issues. We strive to create an enjoyable work environment with support and opportunities for positive career growth. Much of the work will be conducted primarily outdoors and occasionally inside buildings or other structures that may include exposure to inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, bodies of water, moving mechanical parts, electrical equipment, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic waste depending on project requirements. The position requires mobility. Duties involved require moving materials that weigh up to 10-35 pounds on a regular basis, occasionally moving materials that weigh up to 50-75 pounds, and carrying up to 25 pounds over rough terrain for 100 yards. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 50% of the work period while operating equipment such as computer keyboard, mouse, calculator and similar machines. There will be frequent, talking, hearing, standing, moving, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, handling, grasping, feeling, balancing, coordination, sitting, and operating a company vehicle.

title: Manager, Client Financial Reporting
description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve.
