title: Senior Legal Advocate Role - Real Estate - LLB/LLM
description:
About the Company:

Bharath Group is a diversified group headquartered in Bengaluru, operating across Real Estate Development, Infrastructure, Banking & Finance (NBFC), Hospitality, Education, Agriculture, Mining, and Logistics. The Group develops commercial and retail projects, plotted land and managed farmland, and works closely with financial institutions, investors, and partners across India and abroad.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Advocate specialising in Real Estate Law to lead the legal function for the Group's land, development, and commercial projects. The role owns title due diligence, transaction documentation, regulatory approvals, and litigation strategy, and advises management on legal risk across acquisitions, joint developments, sales, and leasing.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead legal due diligence and title verification for land acquisitions, joint development agreements, and project lands, including 30+ year title chains.

- Draft, review, and negotiate sale deeds, agreements to sell, JDAs, GPAs, lease and leave-and-licence agreements, MoUs, and conveyance documents.

- Advise on land conversion, layout and building plan approvals, RERA registration and compliance, and other statutory approvals.

- Handle and supervise civil, property, and revenue litigation; brief and coordinate with external counsel and represent the company before courts, tribunals, and authorities as required.

- Issue legal opinions and title reports for banks and financial institutions for project funding and loans.

- Review leasing and tenancy documentation for commercial and retail (mall) projects.

- Identify legal risks in transactions and recommend mitigation to management.

- Guide and mentor junior advocates and the legal support team; set document standards and checklists.

- Liaise with sub-registrar offices, revenue departments, development authorities, and RERA.

- Maintain a register of litigation, approvals, and key legal documents across group companies.

Required Skills & Competencies:

- Deep knowledge of the Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, Indian Stamp Act, RERA, Specific Relief Act, CPC, and the Karnataka Land Revenue and land reforms laws.

- Strong drafting, negotiation, and opinion-writing skills.

- Proven experience handling property litigation and complex land transactions.

- Ability to lead a team and manage external counsel.

- Sound judgement, integrity, and the ability to explain legal risk clearly to management.

- Working knowledge of Kannada for reading revenue records is preferred.

Qualifications & Experience:

- LLB (3 or 5 year); LLM in Property / Corporate Law is a plus.

- Enrolled with the Bar Council.

- 8 - 15 years of experience in real estate law, with a law firm or in-house with a developer.

description:
Job Title: Harm Reduction Outreach Specialist

Job Summary:

The Harm Reduction Outreach Specialist provides mobile outreach services in the South Bronx providing health education, risk reduction information and safe injection equipment and other supplies to people who use drugs. Conduct Harm Reduction Services and Syringe exchange program enrollments, including review of substance use history, current drug use practices, medical waste disposal practices, and providing low-threshold counseling and education to participants within the agency and on the mobile unit

Primary Duties & Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ability to operate a motor-vehicle (vans).
  • Conduct Harm Reduction Services (HRS) and syringe services program enrollment and distribution at sanctioned locations.
  • Collection of syringe litter waste in the South Bronx.
  • Serve as agency liaison at community forums, events, and planning bodies as appropriate and where assigned.
  • Data collection is required.
  • Conduct Opioid Overdose Reversal Training.
  • Ability to explain, describe, and discuss safer injection practices, other safe drug using strategies, and safer sex options.
  • Provision of and documentation of prevention education, counseling, referrals, safer drug using education, and strategies.
  • Street level outreach for program recruitment and retention, including distribution of health education and risk reduction information.
  • Act as a point person for Buprenorphine referrals and information.
  • Ability to train to conduct rapid HIV and Hepatitis C on the mobile unit.
  • Responsible for ensuring medical waste is handled properly, packed, and stored in a designated area.
  • Preparation, packing, and inventory of syringes and related program supplies.
  • Provision of and documentation of prevention education, counseling, referrals, safer drug using education, and strategies.
  • Ability to distribute high-risk prevention supplies, including female & male condoms, safer smoking kits, and provision of sterile syringes.
  • Assist in monitoring the inventory, stocking and ordering of harm reduction supplies.
  • Plan agency outreach strategies, times, locations and activities.

Qualifications/Criteria:

  • A valid NYS driver’s license is required with a minimum of 3 years of driving experience.
  • Working knowledge of harm reduction theory and practice.
  • Experience with providing harm reduction services to active drug users, the homeless and sex workers.
  • Significant work or personal life experience in the areas of substance use, sex work, and HIV and HCV prevention desired. Skills in the areas of safer injection and safer drug use techniques and overdose prevention, HIV and HCV prevention and treatment desired. Experience in the Bronx and East Harlem preferred.
  • Proven experience as a team leader.
  • Must participate in required training, webinars, and other training requirements.
  • Knowledge of infectious disease transmission and prevention practices for injectors (HIV, Hepatitis C, Opiate Over Dose Prevention and Response) health education, outreach strategies, harm reduction theory, and practice.
  • Good communication skills oral, written, and interpersonal skills.
  • Physically able to climb stairs, move and lift boxes and supply packs weighing up to 20 pounds.
  • Working knowledge of AIRS, eShare.
  • Demonstrated commitment to advocacy and activism, particularly in the crises of COVID-19, HIV/AIDS, homelessness and drug policy.
  • Must be willing to work outdoors at our street sites (sometimes in inclement weather) and conduct intensive outreach.
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) preferred.

Education:

  • High School Graduate or GED.

Portsmouth, New Hampshire, United States

  • You will determine donor eligibility; to include, proper management of informed consent, AIDS education and confidential self-exclusion, medical history interview and acceptance requirements, physical examination, blood testing, and reviewing Serological Protein Electrophoresis (SPE).

  • You will evaluate donor reaction(s), which occurs at the facility as outlined in the SOPs. Follow applicable SOPs for medical emergencies including the development of Center Physician's standing orders and donor transport to emergency care facilities.

  • You will refer to the Center Physician or Medical Affairs (as applicable) when in need of providing unacceptable findings to donors, or guidance concerning medical or technical issues, including donor safety and eligibility.

  • You will support the Hepatitis B and Seasonal Flu vaccination programs for employees as applicable.

  • You will manage employee incidents and determine whether further evaluation is required by occupational health/ER. Refer to EHS guidance regarding employee incidents.

  • You can be a Pandemic Coordinator when authorized by EHS and support investigations associated with pandemic threats within the local community as indicated by EHS or Medical Affairs.


What you bring to Takeda:

  • High school diploma or equivalent to including graduate equivalent of a recognized educational nursing program with state requirements

  • Currently licensed or certified in the state where responsibilities will be assigned: Emergency Medical Technician -Basic (EMT-B), Advanced (EMT-A), Intermediate (EMT-I), and Paramedic (EMT-P), Licensed Practical Nurse / Licensed Vocational Nurse (LPN/LVN), and Registered Nurse (RN)

  • Current Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and AED certification

  • Fulfill state requirements (in state of licensure) for basic IV therapy

  • Satisfactorily complete the FDA approved training requirements for BioLife Medical Support Specialist

  • Two years in a clinical or hospital setting


What Takeda can offer you:

Every day at Takeda, we feel good knowing that what we do helps improve the lives of patients with rare diseases. At BioLife, while you focus on our donors, we will support you. We offer a purpose you can believe in, a team you can count on, opportunities for career growth, and a comprehensive benefits program to include medical/dental, paid time off and retirement benefits, all in a fast-paced, friendly environment.

More about us:

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to bring Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

title: Senior Product Manager, Student Support Services
description:
Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our One Stop and Help Desk offerings. These solutions enable colleges and universities to deliver accessible, responsive support to students, faculty, and staff across voice, chat, and digital channels. This role owns the evolution of a differentiated, scalable service experience—combining contact center operations, Amazon Connect (AWS Connect), AI-powered voice and chat assistants, intelligent self-service, and seamless human-agent support. You will translate institutional needs, operational insights, and emerging technology into a prioritized portfolio strategy, aligning engineering, service delivery, client-facing teams, and executive stakeholders around measurable improvements in customer experience, operational performance, and growth.

A Day in the Life

  • Own and communicate the One Stop and Help Desk product vision, strategy, multi-quarter roadmap, and prioritized backlog, balancing client needs, competitive differentiation, commercial opportunities, technical investment, and operational efficiency
  • Set product direction for Amazon Connect-based omnichannel experiences, including IVR, intelligent routing, queue management, agent desktop/workflows, integrations, reporting, workforce management, and quality assurance; partner with engineering on architectural tradeoffs and scalability
  • Lead the strategy and delivery of conversational AI across voice and chat—including virtual agents, knowledge-grounded answers, automated resolutions, intent recognition, escalation to human agents, and conversation analytics—with explicit quality, safety, and performance measure
  • Conduct market and customer discovery with higher education institutions, frontline agents, service operations, implementation, sales, and client success; map end-to-end service journeys and translate unmet needs into differentiated product opportunities
  • Define business cases, success metrics, and performance targets; own product-level accountability for CSAT, NPS, customer effort, digital containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, call abandonment, agent productivity, and SLA performance, in partnership with operating teams
  • Use contact center analytics, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, financial/operational data, and competitive intelligence to evaluate opportunities, prioritize investments, monitor AI accuracy and escalation effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead discovery through launch and adoption: define outcomes and requirements, guide UX and technical decisions, make scope and priority tradeoffs, ensure release readiness, and equip go-to-market, implementation, and service teams with positioning and enablement
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority; proactively manage dependencies, delivery risks, vendor/platform relationships, and roadmap decisions while mentoring less-experienced product colleagues as appropriate

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Assess the One Stop and Help Desk business, customer segments, economics, service workflows, current roadmap, Amazon Connect architecture, AI capabilities, partner dependencies, and operational scorecard; establish relationships with key leaders and identify immediate risks and opportunities.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Present a clear portfolio assessment, prioritized multi-quarter roadmap, and measurable outcome framework; align product, engineering, operations, and commercial leaders on strategic priorities, AI automation opportunities, and delivery tradeoffs; lead an initial high-value initiative.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Be accountable for execution and demonstrated progress against agreed product KPIs; deliver and measure a material portfolio enhancement, advance the voice/chat AI and self-service strategy, and establish a repeatable process for customer discovery, roadmap governance, and post-launch optimization.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience, including significant ownership of SaaS or technology product strategy and delivery; prior experience with contact center platforms, customer service technology, or managed service-enabled products strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of contact center operations and service delivery, including omnichannel engagement, IVR, routing and queues, workforce management (WFM), quality assurance (QA), service-level agreements (SLAs), and reporting/analytics
  • Hands-on product experience with Amazon Connect (AWS Connect) or a comparable cloud contact center platform; able to make informed decisions about platform capabilities, integrations, vendor dependencies, architectural constraints, and total cost of ownership
  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling conversational AI, chatbots, voice assistants, or automated self-service; understands knowledge management, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, agent handoffs, AI evaluation, and responsible deployment
  • Proven ability to define and improve measurable product and operational outcomes, including CSAT, NPS, customer effort, containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, abandonment, agent productivity, and service quality
  • Strong product leadership skills in discovery, market assessment, strategy, business cases, roadmap prioritization, agile execution, stakeholder influence, and written and executive-level communication; comfortable using Jira, Confluence, and analytics tools
  • Sound commercial and technical judgment; able to work independently through ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, negotiate tradeoffs, and align diverse teams around outcomes rather than feature requests
  • Experience in higher education or EdTech is a plus; commitment to improving the student support experience and using AI to augment—not simply replace—effective human service

title: Special Education Assistant Float (Elementary) - Part-Time
description:
The Special Education Assistant provides direct support to students with disabilities across various elementary school settings. Under the direction and supervision of licensed professional staff, this position assists students with physical, emotional, behavioral, and cognitive needs to support their academic progress, personal care, independence, safety, and participation in the school community.

Special Education Assistants may provide individual or small-group support, assist with classroom instruction and activities, implement teacher-directed strategies, and support students with activities of daily living. Responsibilities may vary based on student needs and building assignments and may include both instructional and personal care support.

Make a Difference Where It Matters Most!
Looking for work that fits your schedule and makes a real difference? The School District of West Allis-West Milwaukee is seeking caring, dependable Special Education Assistants to support students with diverse learning needs. This role is not always easy. It can be physically and mentally demanding, and it calls for patience, flexibility, and resilience on challenging days. But for the right person, it is also deeply rewarding.

In this part-time position, you'll help students build confidence, develop independence, and fully participate in their school community, all while working alongside a collaborative team of teachers and specialists. Your schedule follows the school day, with time off for school breaks, and your work will matter every single day. The connections you build with students will last well beyond the classroom. If you're compassionate, steady under pressure, and ready to take on meaningful work that truly changes lives, we'd love to hear from you.

Schedule and Placement:
We offer flexible part-time schedules (20–30 hours per week) during the 10-month school year. Choose the option that fits your life:
  • Full-day option: Work 2–3 eight-hour days per week, 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
  • Half-day option: Work mornings only or afternoons only, up to 5 days per week.

Assistants are placed in an elementary school based on their availability and the needs of each building. Assignments and responsibilities may vary depending on student needs and district staffing priorities. Flexibility to support different students, classrooms, and buildings may be necessary.

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Provide direct support to students with disabilities under the direction of licensed professional staff and classroom teachers.
  • Assist with classroom activities, including individual and small-group instruction, academic tasks, and teacher-developed educational plans.
  • Support students with physical, emotional, behavioral, and cognitive needs across various educational environments.
  • Assist students with activities of daily living, including dressing, eating, personal hygiene, toileting, and other personal care needs while maintaining student dignity, privacy, and independence.
  • Provide physical assistance with positioning, mobility, transfers, and other student care needs as appropriate.
  • Operate specialized equipment, which may include wheelchair lifts, standing frames, Hoyer lifts, and other adaptive or mobility equipment, following appropriate training and safety procedures.
  • Support students with mobility needs in accessing classrooms, school facilities, transportation, and community-based learning environments.
  • Assist students with safely entering and exiting school transportation when needed.
  • Implement teacher-directed strategies and student support plans, which may include Individualized Education Programs (IEPs), behavior intervention plans, health care plans, and safety plans.
  • Assist with specialized student needs, which may include therapeutic activities, specialized feedings, and other supports as directed by licensed professionals and in accordance with training.
  • Support student supervision and participation in various settings, including classrooms, lunchrooms, playgrounds, arrival and dismissal, field trips, and community outings.
  • Assist teachers and related service providers with activities and strategies designed to promote student learning, development, independence, and inclusion.
  • Provide support during student assessments and testing as directed.
  • Monitor and respond appropriately to student behaviors and needs, maintaining a calm, patient, and professional approach during challenging situations.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with teachers, related service providers, school staff, and administrators while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized learning environment, including cleaning equipment and supplies as needed.
  • Attend meetings and participate in required training and professional development opportunities.
  • Actively support the School District of West Allis-West Milwaukee's mission, vision, values, and strategic plan.

  • Patience, empathy, flexibility, and professionalism when supporting students with diverse learning and personal care needs.
  • Ability to remain calm, exercise sound judgment, and respond appropriately in challenging or unexpected situations.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with students, teachers, related service providers, and other staff.
  • Ability to follow directions, implement teacher-developed plans, and work effectively as part of a collaborative team.
  • Ability to maintain student confidentiality and adhere to district policies, procedures, and safety guidelines.
  • Ability to support students in developing independence while respecting individual needs, privacy, and dignity.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to adapt to changing student and building needs.
  • Ability to work independently when appropriate while maintaining communication with supervising staff.
  • Willingness to learn and utilize specialized equipment, student support strategies, and required safety procedures.

Physical Requirements:

title: Director, Data Science
description:
Director, Data Science

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


About The Team

Capital One was built on the idea that better data and better models make better credit decisions. The Applied AI in Credit team is working on the next chapter of that story. We apply AI models to credit decisioning. These models learn from the full history of how a customer uses credit, and putting them to work in lending decisions is cutting-edge work for the US industry.We own the work end to end. We fine-tune and build models for specific credit decisions, prove them against the models we use today, make them explainable enough to meet the bar that fair lending and model risk management require, and carry them into live credit decisions. Along the way we partner closely with Capital One’s AI researchers on one side and the credit teams who run our card business on the other.

We hire across a range, from data scientists who love building models to analysts who know credit deeply, and we look for people who want to grow toward the other end. If you want to help shape how AI is used in lending, we’d love to talk.


In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
  • Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

title: Technical Lead
description:
Job Description:

Technical Lead support is provided to ensure uninterrupted performance of any approved CALS Change Requests (CRs), as well as O&M activities. Ensure that IRS-identified staff receives the knowledge and skills needed to maintain all programs the Contractor has designed, maintained, tested, and implemented. The activities include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Share information and considerations necessary for the decision-making process when developing solutions for business requirements
  • Provide monthly status reports to CALS leadership.
  • Support all required tasks, all required deliverables, and all work packages
  • Identify, document, and report all risks and issues encountered, escalate as appropriate
  • Attend and actively participate in stakeholder meetings, as needed, to discuss the status of O&M and enhancement activities
  • Develop, facilitate, and maintain schedules and WBS for all CALS applications,including the Tax Court project.
  • Provide weekly Dash Boards to support WBS and Schedules for all CALS application
  • Collaborate with all IT partners on currency initiatives.
  • Identify, develop, and update all ONESDLC artifacts needed for Milestone Readiness
  • Review and Milestone Exit Reviews needed for successful deployment of all impacted software
  • Support Demand Management initiatives, as needed

DESIRED OUTCOME – The Contractor shall provide effective management of all program and project activities to achieve desired cost, schedule, and technical performance and maintain quality deliverables.

Experience Requirement:

  • 10 years total IT experience (5 years senior technical experience + 3 years technical leadership experience)
  • Experienced developer (Java, Oracle, Documentum, Sales Force, Google)
  • Experience executing Cross-team coordination, providing technical guidance,producing quality solutions, maintaining production stability,
  • Experience communicating & mitigating technical risk

Certification & Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education, professional training, certifications, and relevant technical experience.

Project Background:
The IT Compliance organization, Compliance Operations, Legal Systems Section, supports the Office of Chief Counsel (OCC), is the chief legal officer of the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and serves as counsel and legal advisor to the IRS Commissioner on all matters pertaining to the administration and enforcement of the Internal Revenue laws and related statutes, as well as non-tax legal questions. The IT Enterprise Operations Group (EOPS) and User and Network Services (UNS) teams operate and maintain a nationwide technical infrastructure in support of the OCC’s mission- critical automation activities.

The scope of this support effort for the Office of Chief Counsel systems and components, also referred to as the Counsel Automated Legal Systems - CALS:

  • Counsel Automated Systems Environment Management Information System (CASE-MIS).
  • Chief Counsel Macros (CCMACROS).
  • Chief Counsel Check (CCACHECK).
  • Electronic Tax Court Services (eTCS).
  • Electronic Word (eWord).
  • electronic Counsel Inventory Tracking Environment (eCITE).
  • Intelligent Document Management System (IDMS).

For each of the applications outlined above as part of the CALS project, the support team will collaborate with the CALS government team, IT partners, Business Systems Planning (BSP), and Chief Counsel end users to provide application maintenance and change request support.

This includes the following for each application:

  • Break-fix: Analyze, remediate, test, and support deployment of any application Production defects.
  • IT Mandates: Support hardware and software upgrades as dictated by IT to remain in compliance, including Product upgrades of Oracle, Windows, Linux, Documentum, and .NET. This also includes application/platform modernization efforts deemed necessary by IT and Chief Counsel constituents.
  • Tax Reform Updates: Support software upgrades, including design, development, and testing, in support of any mandated tax law or tax code changes. Several changes are initiated annually by US Tax Court and require updates to the eTCS application.
  • Technical Lead: Collaborate with the CALS Government management team to provide support in the following areas: scheduling, Scrum Master activities, One Software Development Life Cycle OneSDLC activities including annual milestone reviews, and Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD methodology and tool adoption.
  • Risk Management: Collaborate with the CALS Government management team to review, Prioritize, remediate, and mitigate and project risks. Document and support, as needed, any required Risk Based Decisions (RBDs).
  • Security Management: Collaborate with the CALS Government team and BSP Security Program Management Officer (SPMO) to review monthly security audit scans, prioritize findings, and work with the appropriate IT partners to remediate and validate the fixes.

title: Harm Reduction Coordinator
description:
Harm Reduction Coordinator

Position Summary :

The Harm Reduction Coordinator oversees the planning, coordination, and day-to-day operations of BOOM!Health’s harm reduction programs, including syringe services, evening services (Tuesday–Friday, 2:00 PM–10:00 PM), Saturday services (8:00 AM–4:00 PM), outreach activities, overdose prevention initiatives, and other low-threshold support services. The Coordinator works collaboratively with participants, community partners, healthcare providers, and program staff to increase access to safer use supplies, naloxone, health education, and linkage to care.

The Coordinator ensures compliance with organizational policies, contract requirements, and harm reduction best practices while promoting participant-centered, trauma-informed, and culturally responsive services that uphold the dignity, autonomy, and self-determination of people who use drugs. This position provides operational oversight and program coordination while fostering a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment for participants and staff.

Key Responsibilities :

• Oversee the day-to-day operations of fixed-site harm reduction services, ensuring a participant-centered, trauma-informed, and low-threshold service environment.

• Implement and monitor program policies, procedures, and practices in accordance with harm reduction principles, contract requirements, and applicable regulations.

• Provide participant-centered support in service settings, engaging individuals in a respectful, nonjudgmental manner that promotes dignity, autonomy, and trust.

• Respond to and de-escalate participant situations as needed, using trauma-informed and harm reduction-informed approaches to maintain safety for participants and staff.

• Conduct community engagement activities, including education on safer substance use, overdose prevention, and available support services.

• Develop and maintain partnerships with community organizations, service providers, and stakeholders through referral networks, MOUs, LOAs, and linkage agreements.

• Coordinate fixed-site service operations and onsite community events.

• Maintain accurate program documentation, participant records, and inventory of harm reduction supplies.

• Support data collection, program reporting, contract deliverables, site visits, and program evaluations.

• Represent BOOM!Health at community meetings, events, and partner organizations.

Qualifications:

• Working knowledge of harm reduction theory and practice.

• Experience providing trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and nonjudgmental services with a strong emphasis on participant-centered care.

• Skilled in de-escalation and conflict resolution in high-need, community-based service environments.

• Experience working in harm reduction, public health, or human services settings supporting people who use drugs and other marginalized communities.

• Ability to foster a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment for participants, including PWUD, PLWHA, LGBTQIA+ individuals, MSM, people experiencing homelessness, and sex workers.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to support coordination of fixed-site program operations in collaboration with program leadership.

• Knowledge of organizational policies, procedures, and regulatory compliance standards.

• Experience with inventory management, including ordering, receiving, tracking, and safe storage of harm reduction supplies.

• Familiarity with data systems such as AIRS and eShare, as well as Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to support training and onboarding of staff and peers in harm reduction practices, as directed.

title: Senior Manager - Forward Deployment Engineering
description:
SENIOR MANAGER FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER.

What You'll Do.

1. Problem Discovery and Business Partnership:

- Work in person in Chennai while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and Global Business Services teams.

- Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs and process reviews with senior stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes.

- Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility and risk.

- Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn't match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations.

2. Technical Leadership and Build:

- Serve as technical lead on complex engagements: own solution design, stay hands-on in the code, and lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on the company's enterprise AI platforms.

- Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph and Lang Chain, with MCP, A2A and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules and human approval steps.

- Set coding standards, evaluation practice and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code.

- Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, show other engineers how to use them well, and make build-versus-buy and platform choices with digital platform and architecture teams.

3. Data and Enterprise Integration:

- Lead integration across Finance and Global Business Services data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, other enterprise platforms and custom solutions.

- Help shape a shared Finance and Global Business Services data and AI foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks.

- Define data contracts, semantic models and access patterns, and extend the shared ontology and business rules, such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties and materiality, that other engineers and agents reuse.

- Set data access, entitlement and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead.

4. Controls, Compliance and Responsible AI:

- Own control design for your solutions.

- Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release.

- Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals and actions are recorded in the decision ledger.

- Enforce responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review and output monitoring.

5. Production, Reliability and Reuse:

- Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response and run costs.

- Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer and root cause analysis for production solutions.

- Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Foundry Observability.

- Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates and accelerators across Finance and Global Business Services, and identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale.

6. Mentoring, Value and Adoption:

- Mentor Manager-level Forward Deployed Engineers, and engineers in Finance and Global Business Services function teams, through design reviews, pairing and code review.

- Contribute to Forward Deployed Engineering playbooks, interview loops and team upskilling.

- Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance and risk reduction.

- Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and Global Business Services stakeholders and Forward Deployed Engineering leadership, and build champions in the business so adoption sticks.

What You Bring.

1. Engineering and AI Delivery:

- 10+ years of software or data engineering experience, including at least three years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, with at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation and monitoring.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.

- Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds.

- Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL.

- Hands-on experience with cloud architecture, ideally Azure; AWS is also considered.

- Includes API-first design, CI/CD and observability.

- Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model and agent versioning.

- Daily use of AI coding agents in your own engineering work, with the judgement to review AI-generated code.

2. Business Partnership and Leadership:

- Able to partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers.

- Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority.

- Experience mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications:

- A Master's degree in a technical field, or a finance or accounting background combined with engineering experience.

- Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A or treasury, or prior work in finance technology.

- Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI or Oracle EPM; comparable enterprise platforms are also considered.

- Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph or Lang Chain, MCP server development and A2A; other orchestration frameworks are also considered.

- Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs or rules engines.

- Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry.

- Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products.

- AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer certification, or the equivalent on other market-leading platforms.

title: Level of Care Assessor
description:

BE PART OF OUR MISSION!

Are you passionate about helping older adults live meaningful, independent lives at home with grace and dignity? BoldAge PACE is an all-inclusive program of care, personalized to meet the individual health and well-being needs of our participants. Our approach is simple: We listen to our participants and their caregivers to truly understand their needs and desires.

Level of Care Assessor

JOB SUMMARY:
The Level of Care (LOC) Assessor is responsible for conducting comprehensive, state-certified evaluations to determine whether prospective participants meet the nursing home level of care requirement for eligibility in the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE). This role involves performing in-home assessments, documenting clinical and functional status, identifying care needs, and collaborating with state agencies and the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to ensure timely, accurate eligibility determinations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct in-home, state-certified level of care assessments for prospective PACE participants.
  • Accurately determine whether individuals meet the nursing facility level of care criteria as required by the State Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS).
  • Coordinate and communicate effectively with state-level personnel to complete and document LOC determinations.
  • Complete all required LOC certification and re-certification training as mandated by the state annually.
  • Enter and manage participant evaluation data within the State’s electronic system and internal records (e.g., EMR).
  • Communicate assessment findings clearly to the Interdisciplinary Team (IDT), contributing to eligibility decisions and enrollment planning.
  • Identify participant needs, health conditions, support systems, and goals to assist in initial care planning.
  • Provide education to participants and families about PACE services and level of care requirements.
  • Independently schedule assessments and follow-ups, demonstrating strong time management and prioritization.
  • Complete monthly re-assessments or re-determinations as required.
  • Participates in organizational quality initiatives by contributing to data accuracy, identifying process improvement opportunities, and supporting efforts to enhance assessment consistency and participant outcomes.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, timely, and aligned with regulatory and organizational standards.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Social Work, Gerontology, or other health-related field (varies by state; licensure may be required).
  • Must hold and maintain active state certification to conduct nursing facility level of care assessments.
  • Prior experience conducting clinical or functional assessments in a healthcare, long-term care, or community-based setting preferred.

PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS:

  • All Employees - Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license, and the minimum state required liability auto insurance.
  • Be medically cleared for communicable diseases and have all immunizations up to date before engaging in direct participant contact.
  • Pass a comprehensive criminal background check that may include, but is not limited to, federal and state Medicare/Medicaid exclusion lists, criminal history, education verification, license verification, reference check, and drug screen.

description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Order Management Specialist I is an integral member of the Finance team, sitting on the verification and execution side of the Quote to Cash workflow. The Order Management Specialist is the first point of contact for validating the approved quote against its supporting documentation, owning quote approvals to trigger order creation, fulfilment, and invoicing. They manage a queue of requests, prioritizing, resolving, or escalating to meet the business needs of Jamf, and are tasked with maintaining efficiency, accuracy, and compliance of transactions within the CRM. This position is a collaborative role that interacts with many teams, serving as the Subject Matter Expert and internal escalation point for order validation, acceptance, fulfilment and returns processing.

  • Review and approve return quotes with close attention to detail, trigger order creation, fulfillment and credit memo. Manage credit memo requirements in coordination with the Finance team, and ensure all returns are processed in the proper order.
  • Confirm order fulfilment is complete and that the order is generated and synced, ready to invoice
  • Troubleshoot fulfilment errors within SLAs

title: Full Time Branch Ambassador - Mclean

Full Time Branch Ambassador - Mclean

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.


As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.


We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.


What You’ll Actually Do

  • The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.
  • The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.
  • The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.
  • The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

What You Bring

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
  • Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
  • Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
  • Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
  • Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.

Why Join Us?


This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.


The Perks


We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Branch stronger than when you started.

  • Available to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, with hours and days subject to change.
  • While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
  • Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience
  • At least 6 months of cash handling experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree
  • 2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
  • Proficient in G-Suite
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

After you apply


You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.


Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

title: Assistant Vice President/Head - Customer Assurance - CPaaS
description:
Head, Customer Assurance

Reporting to: Chief Customer Success Officer, B2B / Enterprise

Portfolio: Connectivity, IoT, CPaaS, security and other enterprise digital services

Purpose of the Job:

Lead end-to-end customer assurance across B2B customers for connectivity and adjacent digital services. Own and build (where required) customer-journey processes, service commitments, shape assurance and observability requirements, and drive coordinated improvements across network infrastructure, overlay digital platforms and operations. The mandate is to establish hyperscale-grade assurance: predictable reliability, rapid restoration, transparent customer communication and automated operations.

Key Responsibilities:

- Customer assurance processes: Design standard processes across in-life support, incidents, service requests, changes, renewals and exit. Define assurance ownership, hand-offs, escalation paths and customer communication for each product and bundled service.

- Assurance and observability requirements: Define customer- and service-level visibility across Connectivity, IoT, CPaaS and Security, including health, availability, performance, dependencies and customer impact. Establish requirements for proactive detection, service dashboards and customer-facing reporting.

- Assurance architecture and platform design: Partner with technology, product and architecture teams to frame the assurance technology architecture and platform designs. Specify service-to-resource mapping, event correlation, ticketing, workflow, define operational acceptance criteria before launch.

- Service commitments and restoration standards: Define product- and customer-specific SLAs, service-level objectives, availability and performance measures, and MTTR targets. Align measurement methods, severity definitions, response and restoration commitments, and reporting with delivery capability and customer contracts.

- NOC response and customer recovery: Establish the operating interface with NOC, service desks, engineering, partners and product teams. Define customer-impact prioritization, major-incident coordination, escalation, restoration verification, root-cause analysis and closure of preventive actions.

- Infrastructure and product reliability: Drive a prioritised improvement backlog with network infrastructure and product owners covering resilience, capacity, redundancy, recovery readiness and recurring defects. Improve serviceability, uptime and product performance through measurable corrective actions.

- Process automation and outcome governance: Drive automation of detection, diagnosis, ticket creation, routing, communication, remediation and closure, with appropriate controls. Track SLA attainment, uptime, MTTR, repeat incidents, customer-impact duration, product performance and automation coverage; agree numerical targets after baselining.

Own:

Customer assurance processes, service-quality governance, operational requirements, customer-impact prioritization and the assurance improvement roadmap within approved policies and budgets.

Jointly agree:

SLAs and restoration targets with product, commercial and delivery teams; assurance architecture and platform designs with technology owners; operational readiness and automation controls with Network and engineering.

Recommend and escalate:

Infrastructure investments, platform enhancements, resilience priorities and systemic service risks. Escalate unresolved cross-functional issues through the Chief Customer Success Officer.

Role boundary:

Accountable for the end-to-end customer assurance framework and improvement outcomes. Infrastructure delivery, platform engineering and day-to-day NOC execution remain with their respective owners, governed through agreed responsibilities and service commitments.

Key Competencies / Skills Required:

- Has led service assurance or network operations function at scale - ideally for enterprise or carrier customers, with accountability for availability and restoration, not just for ticket throughput.

- Technical grounding in IP and transport networks: routing, MPLS, optical and last-mile technologies, and the fault patterns of each. Strong enough to lead escalations personally and to interview & assess technical talent.

- Customer Journey & Process Transformation: Ability to design enterprise service journeys, translate customer needs into operational processes.

- Assurance & Observability Platforms: Ability to define service-health visibility, customer-impact models and correlation requirements; contribute to integrated assurance architecture, platform design, operational acceptance.

- Reliability Engineering & Service Management: Ability to define SLAs and service-level objectives, availability and restoration measures; apply incident, problem, change and resilience disciplines to improve customer-facing service reliability.

- AI & Process Automation: Ability to identify and industrialise AI-assisted detection, diagnosis and workflow automation, including controlled closed-loop remediation, with measurable reductions in manual effort and restoration time.

Experience and Education:

Demonstrated leadership in enterprise customer assurance, service reliability or service operations across Telecom. Experience spanning connectivity and digital services, customer-journey transformation, major-incident governance, SLA management, observability and operational automation.

Proposed education criterion:

Degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

title: Full Time Branch Ambassador - Madison Crescent
description:

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.


As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.


What You’ll Actually Do

  • The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.
  • The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.
  • The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.
  • The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.

South Denver OB/GYN | Four Days Per Week | $90,000–$110,000 per year

OnPoint Medical Group is seeking a compassionate, skilled Advanced Practice Practitioner (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to join our South Denver OB/GYN team full time and support patients participating in the Biote/Hormone program and support other women’s health programs.

This is an opportunity to build meaningful patient relationships, work alongside an experienced clinical team, and contribute to a growing, physician-led healthcare network. If you enjoy combining advanced clinical care with patient education and coordinated follow-up, we would love to meet you.

About the Role

As the Advanced Practice Practitioner supporting our Biote program, as wells as other women’s health functions including NST, hormone consults, prenatal and other exams. This position will also support with triage of patients calling the clinic. You will work four days per week in partnership with physicians and other clinical team members to provide safe, attentive, and personalized care.

You will evaluate, diagnose, and treat patients, manage hormone therapy within the Biote program, complete patients exams and testing, order and interpret laboratory testing, educate patients, maintain accurate records, and help keep the clinic running smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate and manage women's health patients, including taking histories, performing physical and pelvic examinations, and developing individualized treatment plans.
  • Assess, prescribe, and manage Biote hormone therapy within your scope of practice and Biote training requirements.
  • Order, review, and interpret laboratory tests and diagnostic studies, and follow up on abnormal results.

  • Prescribe medications, including controlled substances where clinically appropriate, in compliance with DEA and state regulations.

  • Perform CPR and other clinical interventions consistent with your training, certifications, state regulations, and scope of practice.
  • Communicate delays and relevant care information to patients and families with professionalism and empathy.

Provide exceptional patient care

  • Provide OB triage support and manage patient concerns, including phone triage, lab results, medication refills, and patient portal messages as appropriate.

Help the clinic operate efficiently

  • National certification in your specialty (for example, AANP/ANCC for NPs or NCCPA for PAs)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Release Engineering
location: Hybrid- Any Office (Fremont, CA, Salem, OR, or Pittsburgh, PA)
description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About The Role

Join the team building a modern Software Delivery System focused on secure, high throughput software delivery at scale — powering enterprise-grade, next-generation industrial humanoid robotics.

Every Digit we build, and every update that reaches production, passes through systems Infrastructure Release Engineering owns: the Bazel build system and CI runner platform our developers work in, the test platforms that gate every hardware and software release, the manufacturing software our production line runs on, and the release machine that delivers software over the air to a growing fleet.

We are hiring across this domain at multiple levels and in multiple locations. The software development organization is growing fast, and the platform has to scale with it — handling thousands of pull requests a day — keeping factory software in lockstep with what runs in the field. What we plan to build is orders of magnitude greater than what already exists — you get to shape critical systems in this unique product line.

This role sits at the intersection of:

  • Build and CI platform engineering at organizational scale
  • Test platforms that run component- and whole-robot-scale testing, serving as the enforcement point for hardware and software release gates
  • Manufacturing and fleet software delivery — provisioning through over-the-air update

Key Responsibilities

The list below spans every track and level we are hiring for — specific ownership depends on your background and primary location.

  • Test Infrastructure & CI Reliability: Build and own the platforms that run testing at component and whole-robot scale — runner capacity, test compute, hardware-in-the-loop benches, and flaky-test reliability — enforcing hardware and software release gates, not just software CI.
  • Manufacturing & Line Software: Keep manufacturing and validation software in versioned parity with production robot software, own the test infrastructure it runs on, and automate the workflows and monitoring that keep on-call light as the line scales.
  • Release & Fleet Delivery: Run provisioning and over-the-air update as one continuous, auditable pipeline — staged rollout, signed provenance, auto-rollback — and carry release and fleet on-call.
  • Collaboration & Standardization: Drive adoption of build, test, and release standards across engineering teams, and work directly with robot software, firmware, manufacturing, test, security, and cloud teams to create clarity where ownership is ambiguous.

What We're Aiming For

  • A CI platform that absorbs organizational growth without capacity firefighting — handling thousands of pull requests a day, core loop under 10 minutes, full pipeline under 20 minutes.
  • A trustworthy signal — test flakes quarantined with owners and expiry dates, main branch kept green against a published SLO.
  • Manufacturing software in parity with production, and provisioning/OTA managed as one auditable pipeline with signed provenance end to end.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional software or infrastructure engineering experience with demonstrated ownership at your level — 2+ years for mid-level scope, 5+ years for senior scope.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and real fluency on Linux systems.
  • Hands-on ownership of infrastructure other engineers depend on: CI, build, test, release, or manufacturing and lab tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with physical, on-prem infrastructure — manufacturing line stations, lab benches, or similar hardware you can walk up to — not purely cloud or remote-only tooling.
  • Demonstrated experience turning ad-hoc scripts or manual processes into versioned, tested, maintainable systems.
  • Debugging instincts and communication that hold up across functional teams — engineering, manufacturing, and test.
  • Authorization to work in the USA.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with Bazel or a comparable build system, remote execution/caching (EngFlow or equivalent), and test-impact selection.
  • Robotics, embedded, or hardware-in-the-loop experience, including cross-platform targets (ARM, Jetson, Linux BSPs, firmware).
  • Experience in manufacturing or lab environments: test benches, end-of-line test, MES or traceability databases, device provisioning, PKI, or secure/measured boot.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Datadog, Artifactory, and GitHub Actions at production scale.

Locations

  • Fremont, CA — Hybrid. Integration testing, close to the robot hardware.
  • Salem, OR — Hybrid. Manufacturing, at our validation line.
  • Pittsburgh, PA — Hybrid. Integration testing, close to the robot hardware.

All openings on this posting are hybrid, based at one of these three offices — there is no fully remote option. Please specify your location preference, and we will work out the best fit for your background during the hiring-manager screen.

Why This Role?

  • Build the foundation: Every line of code shipped to Digit flows through the systems you own. You'll close the scale gap before the load arrives.
  • Zero-to-one + scale: You arrive before the patterns calcify.
  • Define the standards: Your decisions become the defaults the organization operates on.
  • High-trust culture: Collaborate directly with robotics, firmware, security, manufacturing, and cloud engineering teams across a distributed Infrastructure org.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Salary Range
$175,000—$274,000 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

  • 401(k) Plan: Includes a 6% company match.

title: 3D Lab Printing Engineer – 3DQ Lab
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Rotating - 08 Hour (United States of America)

The Stanford Health Care 3D and Quantitative Imaging Laboratory (3DQ Lab) is a specialized interdisciplinary center within the Stanford Department of Radiology. Its core mission is to develop and apply innovative software and visualization techniques to analyze medical imaging data. These methods directly translate complex 2D data into actionable clinical models.

The lab leverages advanced image-processing platforms to support multiple medical specialties, including cardiothoracic surgery, oncology, neurosurgery, and pediatrics.

3D & 4D Visualization: Converts standard CT and MRI scans into multiplanar reconstructions, volume-rendered graphics, and virtual endoscopies. The lab uses 4D temporal rendering to assess cardiac and anatomical structures actively in motion.

The TRAC Program: The Tumor Response Assessment Criteria (TRAC) team standardizes oncology tracking. They track the precise longitudinal changes of tumor sizes over time across multi-interval follow-ups to map overall treatment effectiveness.

Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement (TMVR): Provides comprehensive volumetric measurements and mapping of the venous delivery pathway, helping cardiologists predict post-procedure device performance.

Medical 3D Printing & Modeling: Segments complex anatomies to print physical patient-specific surgical guides, custom orthotics, and full-scale bone structures for custom medical hardware configuration.

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The 3D Printing Engineer is an advanced technical role responsible for developing, producing, and optimizing patient-specific anatomical models, surgical planning tools, and related 3D printing applications. This position combines clinical collaboration with technical expertise, translating physician requirements and complex medical imaging data (CT/MRI) into high-quality physical and digital models. The role operates and maintains advanced 3D printing technologies, develops and refines printing workflows and protocols, supports evaluation and implementation of new technologies, and serves as a technical resource for medical 3D printing activities across clinical, educational, and research initiatives.

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Performs advanced image segmentation, model preparation, and medical 3D printing workflows using specialized software and equipment.

  • Operates, maintains, and troubleshoots 3D printers and related systems.

  • Collaborates with physicians, radiologists, and clinical teams to translate clinical requirements into patient-specific anatomical models, surgical planning tools, and related outputs.

  • Develops, implements, and optimizes 3D printing workflows, print protocols, and quality assurance procedures.

  • Performs quality assurance activities related to 3D printing processes, equipment, and outputs.

  • Evaluates, tests, and implements new software, materials, equipment, and technologies related to medical 3D printing and additive manufacturing.

  • Maintains documentation, workflow tracking, and inventory related to 3D printing operations.

  • Provides technical guidance and training to staff and users of 3D printing technologies and workflows.

  • Assists with research and educational activities related to medical 3D printing as needed.

  • Ensures compliance with departmental safety procedures and operational standards.

  • Serves as a technical subject matter expert for medical 3D printing technologies, additive manufacturing workflows, and associated applications.


Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, imaging sciences, health sciences, or related field required, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


Experience Qualifications

  • Three (3) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience in medical 3D printing, imaging, engineering support, or related technical field required.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of medical 3D printing, additive manufacturing technologies, image segmentation, model preparation, and post-processing workflows.

  • Advanced knowledge of software applications and systems related to medical imaging and 3D printing.

  • Ability to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain specialized 3D printing equipment and related systems.

  • Ability to analyze technical issues and develop effective solutions.

  • Ability to develop, validate, and optimize printing workflows, protocols, and quality assurance processes.

  • Ability to consult and communicate effectively with physicians, radiologists, clinicians, engineers, and technical staff regarding medical 3D printing applications and solutions.

  • Ability to train and provide technical guidance to staff and users.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain organized workflow processes.

  • Knowledge of safety procedures and operational standards related to 3D printing technologies and materials.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across operational, clinical, and technical teams.

  • Advanced knowledge of medical imaging datasets and the conversion of imaging data into patient-specific physical and digital models.

  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to medical 3D printing operations and applications.


Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of current trends and technologies related to medical 3D printing and advanced visualization.

  • Experience working in a healthcare or academic medical center environment.

  • Experience with imaging segmentation software and additive manufacturing technologies.

  • Demonstrates commitment to safe work practices and operational excellence.

title: Quantitative Internship – Hong Kong
description:
ABOUT EXODUSPOINT

ExodusPoint Capital, founded in 2017 by Michael Gelband, began managing investor capital in 2018. The firm employs a global multi-strategy investment approach, seeking to deliver compelling asymmetric returns by combining complementary liquid strategies managed by experienced investment professionals within a robust risk framework. ExodusPoint brings together an accomplished team with hands-on experience running multi-manager businesses to create an institutional investment management firm.

Quantitative Research Intern – Systematic FICC - Hong Kong

About the Team

The Systematic Rates team researches and runs fully systematic, data-driven strategies in global interest FICC markets. We combine solid statistics, careful engineering and a good feel for how markets work to build and improve systematic trading strategies.

The Role

You'll work closely with the portfolio manager. You'll do hands-on research and development across the whole strategy process, and you'll own real projects with real impact, not side tasks.

Responsibilities

  • Research, prototype and backtest systematic strategies across FICC products such as swaps and foreign exchange.
  • Build and maintain production pipelines, research tools and analytics libraries.
  • Run statistical analysis on market data: signal research, factor analysis, regime analysis, and transaction cost and capacity studies.
  • Help monitor and analyse the performance and risk of live strategies.
  • Write clean, tested, well-documented code that the team can rely on and reuse.

Requirements

  • Strong coding skills. You're proficient in Python (or a similar language). You can design, write, debug and explain your own code. We expect real engineering ability, not just prompting AI tools for code you can't reason about.
  • Strong math and statistics. You're comfortable with probability, linear algebra, regression and time-series analysis.
  • Basic knowledge of financial instruments. You understand FICC market at a foundational level, and you're keen to learn more.

Nice to Have

  • Experience on a fixed income or rates desk (trading, research or strategy). This is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Experience with pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels or similar, plus SQL and version control (Git).
  • Experience with backtesting frameworks, or with large and messy financial datasets.

Availability

  • Start date is as soon as possible.
  • Full-time placement preferred for a season (e.g., an off-cycle).
  • Duration will be 3 - 6 months in our Hong Kong office
  • Part-time candidates can be considered who can commit to at least 4 days a week.

This is more than just a reporting role. You'll be encouraged to challenge existing processes, identify trends and recommend improvements based on the data.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and maintaining interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Writing SQL queries to extract, manipulate and analyse data from multiple systems.
  • Working with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into reporting solutions.
  • Automating existing reports and improving reporting processes.
  • Analysing KPIs, performance trends and operational data to identify areas for improvement.
  • Supporting data migration and system improvement projects.
  • Working with SSRS and other reporting tools to deliver accurate, accessible information.
  • Helping operational teams understand and make better use of their data.


Ideal Experience


This company is looking for someone who is technically capable, naturally curious and confident working with people across different areas of a business.


Ideally, you'll have:

  • At least 2 years' experience in a Business Intelligence, Data Analyst or similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboard and report development.
  • Good SQL querying skills and experience working with data from different sources.
  • Experience gathering requirements and working directly with non-technical stakeholders.
  • An understanding of reporting automation, data quality and performance analysis.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge requirements and suggest improvements.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and an interest in using data to improve business performance.
  • Experience with SSRS, data migrations or operational management systems would be beneficial, but isn't essential.


This is an excellent opportunity for a BI Analyst who wants to develop their technical skills while gaining greater exposure to stakeholders, business analysis and wider data projects.


**Please note that this organisation does not offer Visa sponsorship so applications will only be accepted from data professionals who have full right-to-work in the UK and who can attend site regularly in Suffolk.


Please get in touch with Matt at Agilis Search to discuss further.


Looking forward to your application.
