title: Incident Manager III
description:
Title: Incident Manager III

Description:
Solutions³ LLC is supporting a U.S. Government customer to provide support for onsite incident response to civilian Government agencies and critical asset owners who experience cyber-attacks, providing immediate investigation and resolution. Contract personnel perform investigations to characterize the severity of breaches, develop mitigation plans, and assist with the restoration of services.

Solutions³ LLC is seeking an experienced Cyber Incident Manager to support this critical mission.

Salary Range: $94,000 - $112,000
Location: Arlington, VA
Job Type: Onsite

Eligibility:
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Must have an active TS/SCI clearance
  • Must be able to obtain DHS Suitability prior to starting employment
  • 5+ years of directly relevant experience in cyber incident management or cybersecurity operations
Responsibilities Include:
  • Correlating incident data to identify specific trends in reported incidents
  • Recommending defense in depth principles and practices (i.e. Defense in Multiple Places, layered defenses, security robustness, etc.)
  • Performing Computer Network Defense incident triage to include determining scope, urgency, and potential impact
  • Researching and compiling known resolution steps or workarounds to enable mitigation of potential Computer Network Defense incidents within the enterprise
  • Applying cybersecurity concepts to the detection and defense of intrusions into small, and large-scale IT networks, and conduct cursory analysis of log data
  • Monitoring external data sources to maintain currency of Computer Network Defense threat condition and determine which security issues may have an impact on the enterprise
  • Identifying the cause of an incident and recognizing the key elements to ask external entities when learning the background and potential infection vector of an incident,
  • Receiving and analyzing network alerts from various sources within the enterprise and determine possible causes of such alerts
  • Tracking and documenting Computer Network Defense (CND) incidents from initial detection through final resolution, and work with other components within the organization to obtain and coordinate information pertaining to ongoing incidents
  • Providing support during assigned shifts.
Required Skills:
  • Knowledge of incident response and handling methodologies
  • Having close familiarity with NIST 800-62 (latest revision), and FISMA standards as they pertain to reporting incidents
  • Ability to prioritize incidents, investigate and describe tactics used in phishing campaigns, as well as recognize gaps in incident reporting
  • Knowledge of general attack stages (e.g., foot printing and scanning, enumeration, gaining access, escalation of privileges, maintaining access, network exploitation, covering tracks, etc.)
  • Skill in recognizing and categorizing types of vulnerabilities and associated attacks
  • Knowledge of basic system administration and operating system hardening techniques, Computer Network Defense policies, procedures, and regulations
  • Knowledge of different operational threat environments (e.g., first generation [script kiddies], second generation [non nation-state sponsored], and third generation [nation-state sponsored])
  • Knowledge of system and application security threats and attack methods (e.g., buffer overflow, mobile code, cross-site scripting, PL/SQL and injections, race conditions, covert channel, replay, return- oriented attacks, and malicious code)
Desired Skills:
  • Knowledge of different operational threat environments (e.g., first generation [script kiddies], second generation [non nation-state sponsored], and third generation [nation-state sponsored])
  • Knowledge of system and application security threats and attack methods (e.g., buffer overflow, mobile code, cross-site scripting, PL/SQL and injections, race conditions, covert channel, replay, return- oriented attacks, and malicious code)
Desired Certifications: GCIH, GCFA GISP, GCED, CCFP or CISSP
Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in Incident Management, Operations Management, Cybersecurity, or related degree; or High School Diploma and 7+ years of incident management or cybersecurity experience

title: Associate Frontend Developer, UI/UX
description:
Company Mission: Rhoback is a community of passionate and motivated people looking to generate positivity, bring people together, and inspire activity by creating high-quality products and engaging content for those who seek inspiration, motivation, and connection with a #craveactivity mentality.

The Role

Rhoback is seeking a motivated Associate Frontend Developer to join our growing E-Commerce team. In this role you will build and refine the customer-facing experience on rhoback.com, turning Creative's designs into fast, polished interfaces and owning the frontend work behind every product drop and marketing campaign.

You will report directly to our Marketing Director and work day to day with our Senior E-Commerce Solutions Architect on technical direction and code review. you build a custom frontend using frameworks like React, Next.js, etc. This position is located in-person at Rhoback's Charlottesville, VA headquarters. It is ideal for someone energized by growth and ready to make a real impact in the activewear market.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain frontend components in React, with an eye toward reusability, accessibility, and clean markup
  • Partner with the Creative Marketing team to translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate frontend experiences using our CMS and Visual Editor
  • Own the UI/UX quality of the site end to end, from homepage and navigation through Product, Collection, and landing pages, including layout, imagery, and the details that make browsing feel effortless
  • Build landing pages for marketing campaigns and digital advertising
  • Build and own the process for new product drops: everything required on the website to go live with new product categories
  • Manage and optimize product data, metadata, and assets so they render correctly and read well across the site
  • Monitor site performance and drive optimizations for load times, mobile responsiveness, Core Web Vitals, and overall user experience
  • Implement customizations and feature enhancements as directed by the Senior E-Commerce Solutions Architect
  • Collaborate with Marketing and E-Commerce to troubleshoot issues, ship new features, and roll out seasonal aesthetic updates
  • Debug and resolve issues promptly; regularly test site features for bugs and performance problems
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain clear documentation of all development work
  • Provide technical support to the front-end and back-end teams to keep the site running smoothly

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 1–2 years of frontend or e-commerce development experience
  • Strong skills in React, JavaScript, HTML, and modern CSS
  • Demonstrated eye for UI detail: spacing, typography, responsive behavior, and interaction states
  • Working knowledge of Shopify and its product data model
  • Basic proficiency with version control systems such as Git
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly
  • Eagerness to learn and stay current on frontend and e-commerce trends
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
  • No-task-too-small attitude and genuine team-player mentality

Preferred

  • Experience using Figma for design-to-development handoff
  • Experience with a component-driven CSS approach such as Tailwind, CSS Modules, or styled-components
  • Experience with a Content Managemet System (CMS) or Visual Editor tool (Pack, Contentful, Sanity, or similar)
  • Familiarity with technical search engine optimization (SEO) and accessibility best practices
  • Exposure to headless commerce architectures

What Success Looks Like

  • Pages you build match the Figma spec and hold up across breakpoints without Creative having to send them back
  • The site looks and feels right end to end; with UI issues caught before customers find them
  • New product drops go live on schedule with complete, accurate data, metadata, and assets
  • Marketing campaigns have the landing pages they need, built on time
  • Site performance metrics trend in the right direction
  • You're a reliable bridge between Creative, Marketing, and the Engineering team, with communication that is proactive rather than reactive
  • Your documentation is clean enough that a teammate can pick up your work without a lengthy handoff

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Portfolio, GitHub profile, or live site examples demonstrating frontend or e-commerce work strongly preferred


Physical Requirement (if applicable)

This role may involve performing job-related tasks that occasionally require physical activity, such as lifting, pushing, or pulling items 10 lbs or more, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rhoback is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Compensation

Base salary range: $65,000 – $85,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Additional rewards may include performance bonuses, long-term incentives, an FTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.

You may be assigned additional duties, activities, or responsibilities to support your professional growth and development within the organization and to meet evolving business needs. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or activities associated with this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may be modified, expanded, reassigned, or new ones assigned at any time, with or without notice.

description:

Experience Requirement:

Certification & Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education, professional training, certifications, and relevant technical experience.
  • Agile/DevSecOps, and CI/CD. ISTQB CTFL required;
  • CTAL- TM preferred.

Project Background:
The IT Compliance organization, Compliance Operations, Legal Systems Section, supports the Office of Chief Counsel (OCC), is the chief legal officer of the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and serves as counsel and legal advisor to the IRS Commissioner on all matters pertaining to the administration and enforcement of the Internal Revenue laws and related statutes, as well as non-tax legal questions. The IT Enterprise Operations Group (EOPS) and User and Network Services (UNS) teams operate and maintain a nationwide technical infrastructure in support of the OCC’s mission- critical automation activities.

The scope of this support effort for the Office of Chief Counsel systems and components, also referred to as the Counsel Automated Legal Systems - CALS:

  • Counsel Automated Systems Environment Management Information System (CASE-MIS).
  • Chief Counsel Macros (CCMACROS).
  • Chief Counsel Check (CCACHECK).
  • Electronic Tax Court Services (eTCS).
  • Electronic Word (eWord).
  • electronic Counsel Inventory Tracking Environment (eCITE).
  • Intelligent Document Management System (IDMS).

For each of the applications outlined above as part of the CALS project, the support team will collaborate with the CALS government team, IT partners, Business Systems Planning (BSP), and Chief Counsel end users to provide application maintenance and change request support.

This includes the following for each application:

  • Break-fix: Analyze, remediate, test, and support deployment of any application Production defects.
  • IT Mandates: Support hardware and software upgrades as dictated by IT to remain in compliance, including Product upgrades of Oracle, Windows, Linux, Documentum, and .NET. This also includes application/platform modernization efforts deemed necessary by IT and Chief Counsel constituents.
  • Tax Reform Updates: Support software upgrades, including design, development, and testing, in support of any mandated tax law or tax code changes. Several changes are initiated annually by US Tax Court and require updates to the eTCS application.
  • Technical Lead: Collaborate with the CALS Government management team to provide support in the following areas: scheduling, Scrum Master activities, One Software Development Life Cycle OneSDLC activities including annual milestone reviews, and Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD methodology and tool adoption.
  • Risk Management: Collaborate with the CALS Government management team to review, prioritize, remediate, and mitigate and project risks. Document and support, as needed, any required Risk Based Decisions (RBDs).
  • Security Management: Collaborate with the CALS Government team and BSP Security Program Management Officer (SPMO) to review monthly security audit scans, prioritize findings, and work with the appropriate IT partners to remediate and validate the fixes.

title: Rehabilitation Case Manager (RCM)
description:
Rehabilitation Case Manager – Adult Neurorehabilitation

Location: Creedmoor, NC

Company: Learning Services, A Collage Rehabilitation Partner

Employment Type: Full-Time

Ready to make a meaningful impact? Join a dynamic organization that provides exceptional neurological rehabilitation to adults with brain injuries.

For over 35 years, Collage Rehabilitation Partners has partnered with patients, families, and funders across the country to move lives forward. Known by our trusted names across the country—Learning Services, ReMed, Tree of Life, Collage Home & Community Rehabilitation Partners, and Collage Nursing & Homecare Partners—we are one unified company on a single mission: delivering specialized, expert neurorehabilitation from inpatient facilities to home-based care. Same exceptional care, same dedicated teams—fully connected.

Step into a career and join a team whose mission is to move lives forward every day!!

About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Rehabilitation Case Manager to oversee the implementation of client treatment plans from admission through discharge and follow-up for our programs in Creedmoor, NC.

In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for clients, families, healthcare providers, and funders—coordinating therapy schedules, leading interdisciplinary team meetings, and maintaining clinical documentation to ensure high-quality care and seamless treatment progression.

Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions

  • Case Management & Goal Alignment: Lead interdisciplinary treatment team meetings to set, monitor, and revise rehabilitation goals. Help the clinical team remain focused on recovery milestones and discharge plans.
  • Client Advocacy & Direct Support: Meet regularly with clients to incorporate their personal goals into care plans. Advocate for client needs and provide guidance across all phases of care. Support direct client care or assist with transportation to medical appointments as needed.
  • Clinical Collaboration: Work alongside the Clinical Director, direct care staff, and external physicians to design strategies that support comprehensive care plans.
  • Family & Stakeholder Engagement: Maintain consistent contact with client families and support networks to deliver updates, education, and orientation.
  • Funder & Financial Management: Monitor care programs according to funding guidelines, facilitate alternative/future funding sources, and complete required documentation to uphold billing integrity.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough, timely, and accurate client charts and log notes in accordance with state regulations, HIPAA/HITECH guidelines, and professional standards.
  • Program Support: Assist with clinical data collection for company-wide quality assurance and outcome initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, human services, or a related field required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Certifications: Certified Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC) or Certified Case Manager (CCM) designation preferred.
  • Experience: Hands-on case management experience within the healthcare industry. Demonstrated ability in crisis management, needs assessment, and treatment plan formulation.
  • Driving Requirements: Valid driver’s license with a record of responsible driving behavior. Must have the ability to travel and/or operate a vehicle for up to 30% of the time spent working in this position.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Retirement & Security: 401(k) plan and short/long-term disability options.

  • Ensure activation data, reporting, and optimization recommendations are accurate, timely, and aligned with client objectives.

  • Build deeper expertise in your assigned Commerce Media specialty while developing awareness of adjacent platforms and the broader commerce ecosystem.
  • Understand how Commerce Media connects to client objectives, retail dynamics, Commerce Operations, creative, analytics, and the broader media plan.

Stanford Health Care

title: Enrollment Specialist
description:
Join BoldAge PACE and Make a Difference!

Why work with us?

  • A People First Environment: We make what is important to those we serve important to us.
  • Make an Impact: Enhance the quality of life for seniors.
  • Professional Growth: Access to training and career development.


Competitive Compensation:

  • Medical/Dental
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 401K with Match*
  • Life Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Program

BE PART OF OUR MISSION!

Are you passionate about helping older adults live meaningful, independent lives at home with grace and dignity? BoldAge PACE is an all-inclusive program of care, personalized to meet the individual health and well-being needs of our participants. Our approach is simple: We listen to our participants and their caregivers to truly understand their needs and desires.


ENROLLMENT SPECIALIST - HYBRID


JOB SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Director of Business Development, the Enrollment Specialist is responsible for guiding prospective participants and their families through the enrollment process and converting qualified referrals into program enrollments. This role serves as the primary point of contact for prospects, building trusted relationships while helping individuals understand the benefits and requirements of the PACE program.


Enrollment Specialists represent BoldAge PACE with professionalism and purpose, embodying our values of People First, Seek to Understand, Exceed Expectations, Do the Right Thing, and Be Bold. They work closely with Outreach Specialist, Enrollment Advisors, Benefits Specialists, Level of Care Assessors, and the Interdisciplinary Team to ensure a seamless and supportive experience for each prospective participant from referral through enrollment.


This role combines strong interpersonal skills, consultative enrollment conversations, and coordination across teams to help older adults and their families make informed decisions about joining the BoldAge PACE program.


ESSESNTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assume ownership of prospects upon handoff from the Enrollment Advisor when prospects are prepared to move forward with enrollment or require in-person engagement to support decision-making.
  • Guide prospective qualified participants and their families through the enrollment process from post-intake through completed program enrollment, conducting consultative conversations to understand needs and align them with PACE services and benefits.
  • Clearly present program services, eligibility requirements, and enrollment expectations to prospective participants, caregivers, and family members.
  • Convert qualified referrals into enrollments by leading prospect decision-making and leveraging in-person experiences, including tours and Day-in-the-Life visits, to build trust and drive enrollment.
  • Coordinate and execute all enrollment activities with internal partners, including Benefits Specialists, Level of Care Assessors, and the Interdisciplinary Team, to ensure enrollment readiness and completion.
  • Actively manage enrollment timelines to ensure timely progression from qualification to enrollment, identifying and resolving delays or barriers.
  • Travel within the service area to meet prospects in their homes, healthcare facilities, or community settings to support enrollment.
  • Complete and finalize collection of all required enrollment documentation, including obtaining medical records and coordinating with healthcare providers and partners, using in-person engagement when necessary to ensure all forms, consents, and records are secured to support enrollment.
  • Conduct the Enrollment Conference and finalize participant enrollment in accordance with CMS regulations, including execution of the Enrollment Agreement and Interim Care Plan and provision of all required enrollment materials.
  • Support prospective participants and families in navigating the Medicaid eligibility process in collaboration with the Benefits Specialists and state agencies.
  • Represent the needs and goals of prospective participants during discussions with the interdisciplinary team.
  • Maintain responsive communication with prospects, caregivers, and referral partners throughout the enrollment process.
  • Maintain timely and accurate documentation of prospect interactions and enrollment activities in the CRM and EMR systems.
  • Support new participants and caregivers during the initial transition into the PACE program, including the first three months following enrollment.
  • Receive and execute warm handoffs from Enrollment Advisors, partnering with Outreach Specialist and internal teams to ensure a seamless transition from referral generation through enrollment.
  • Participate in community outreach activities when needed to support enrollment opportunities.
  • Participate in team meetings, continuing education, and professional development to maintain knowledge of PACE principles and messaging, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Maintain confidentiality, uphold all OSHA and infection control protocols, and contribute to a safe and positive work environment.
  • Support organizational quality improvement initiatives and represent BoldAge PACE with integrity in all internal and external interactions.
  • Perform other duties assigned to support organizational goals and BoldAge PACE operations.



EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare Administration, or Human Services preferred.
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role required; experience in healthcare intake, call center operations, patient access, admissions, or inside sales preferred.
  • Experience managing high-volume inbound and outbound communications, including phone, text, and email.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple prospects in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining accurate, timely documentation
  • Knowledge of PACE, Medicaid, Medicare, or health care programs preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience working with older adults, caregivers, or vulnerable populations preferred.


PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license, and the minimum state required liability auto insurance.
  • Be medically cleared for communicable diseases and have all immunizations up to date before engaging in direct participant contact.
  • Pass a comprehensive criminal background check that may include, but is not limited to, federal and state Medicare/Medicaid exclusion lists, criminal history, education verification, license verification, reference check, and drug screen.


BoldAge PACE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Import Specialist - Air & Sea Freight
description:
Import Specialist – Air and Ocean Freight

Title: Import Specialist – Air and Ocean Freight

Reports To: Head of Freight Forwarding Operations

Division: Freight Forwarding Operations

Location: Detroit, MI

Status: Non-exempt (hourly, overtime-eligible)

About the Company

Emons is a global freight forwarding and customs brokerage company, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Romulus, Michigan. We provide air freight, ocean freight, multi-modal transport, warehousing, and customs brokerage services through a network of over 100 offices and 200 gateways worldwide. Our teams work with clients in industries like aerospace, automotive, electronics, retail, and manufacturing to deliver affordable, reliable, and transparent shipping solutions. We value clear communication, quick problem solving, and a team that puts clients first.

Job Summary

The Import Specialist coordinates and executes international air and ocean import shipments from origin to final destination, ensuring cargo moves on time, accurately, and in compliance with applicable regulations while delivering exceptional customer service.

This role is the primary operational contact for customers, overseas agents, carriers, customs brokers, and service providers, and plays a key part in shipment visibility, regulatory compliance, and vendor cost management.

Job Responsibilities

Import Operations

  • Coordinate and manage air and ocean import shipments from origin through final delivery.
  • Review shipping documentation for accuracy and completeness before cargo arrives.
  • Arrange cargo release, coordinate customs clearance with customs brokers and government agencies, and schedule final inland transportation.
  • Monitor shipment milestones and proactively manage exceptions and delays.
  • Communicate with airlines, ocean carriers, overseas offices, and agent partners.
  • Follow U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), TSA, and FMC requirements and company procedures.

Financial Management

  • Prepare freight quotations for customers and overseas agents.
  • Ensure timely, accurate customer billing and complete capture of costs and revenue on each file.
  • Help resolve billing discrepancies and vendor invoice disputes, following company financial controls.

Customer Service and Continuous Improvement

  • Resolve customer inquiries and operational issues promptly and professionally, and provide timely shipment status updates to customers and internal teams.
  • Identify and support process improvements, new systems, and operational standards, and stay current on industry regulations and best practices.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in international freight forwarding, logistics, customs brokerage, or transportation, including air and ocean imports.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of international transportation and import procedures.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines.
  • Strong customer service, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Preferred

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of U.S. Customs import processes and documentation.

Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Compensation: $24–$28 per hour, depending on experience

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO & more

title: Early Childhood Director
description:
Title: Early Childhood Director (ECD)

Supervisor: Chief Operating Officer

Site Location: The Boys & Girls Club of Clifton – 181 Colfax Ave, Clifton NJ, 07013

Exempt/Nonexempt: Exempt


About the Boys & Girls Club of Clifton & Gingerbread House


The Boys & Girls Club of Clifton (BGCC) serves thousands of young people each year through safe, high-quality programs that support Academic Success, Good Character & Citizenship, and Healthy Lifestyles.


The Early Childhood Education Department (ECED) includes:

  • Gingerbread House Day Care – Full-day program
  • KinderKare – For children currently enrolled in kindergarten
  • CELA A/B/S – Before and After School programs for children enrolled in Clifton Public Schools preschool

These programs provide a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment for children ages 2.5–4, grounded in developmentally appropriate practice and positive youth development.


Position Summary

The Early Childhood Director (ECD) provides overall leadership, coordination, and management of BGCC’s Early Childhood Education Department. The ECD leads daily operations of Gingerbread House, KinderKare, and CELA A/B/S programs; manages and develops staff; ensures regulatory compliance; oversees high-quality curriculum and care; builds strong relationships with families and community partners; and supports the strategic growth of early childhood programs. The ECD is both a strategic leader and a hands-on presence in classrooms and program spaces.


Key Responsibilities:


Program Leadership, Curriculum & Quality

  • Oversee daily operations of all ECED programs, ensuring smooth schedules, routines, and developmentally appropriate practices.
  • Implement, assess, and continuously improve a high-quality, play-based curriculum aligned with early childhood best practices and BGCC youth development outcomes.
  • Conduct regular classroom observations and promote trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and inclusive learning environments.

Licensing, Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure full compliance with NJDCF, NJDOH, and all state and local childcare licensing regulations.
  • Maintain accurate child and staff records, attendance, incident reports, and required documentation.
  • Stay current on licensing requirements and ensure staff follow all regulations, including mandated reporting.

Staff Management, Coaching & Culture

  • Recruit, onboard, supervise, evaluate, and schedule staff to maintain proper ratios and continuity of care.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, professional development, and support to foster a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.
  • Model professionalism, integrity, and leadership for staff, children, and families.

Family, School & Community Partnerships

  • Build strong, trusting relationships with families through clear communication, conferences, and engagement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Clifton Public Schools and community partners to support student transitions and strengthen program impact.

Operations, Budget & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ensure ECED spaces are safe, clean, welcoming, and well-equipped for high-quality care and instruction.
  • Manage budgets, vendors, and resources in collaboration with Club leadership and cross-functional teams.

Safety, Crisis Response & Professional Conduct

  • Champion safety, emergency preparedness, confidentiality, and proper facility maintenance.
  • Effectively problem-solve, manage crises, and complete all required training and professional development.


Physical Demands:

Standing, walking, occasional running/jogging, leaning, bending, and sitting. Must be able to lift 30 lbs.


Qualifications

Required:

  • Meets all NJDCF requirements for a center director
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Early Childhood Education or related field
  • Pre-K-3 Certification
  • Experience in Early Childhood or Childcare settings with increasing responsibility
  • Experience supervising or training staff
  • Strong understanding of Early Childhood Development and positive behavior guidance
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to maintain boundaries and confidentiality
  • Ability to pass all required background checks and health clearances
  • Valid driver’s license

Preferred:

  • Director, Assistant Director, or Lead Teacher experience in a licensed center
  • Familiarity with Creative Curriculum or similar play-based curricula
  • Experience with diverse children and families, including special needs
  • Bilingual or multilingual (especially English/Spanish)

Schedule

Full-time, primarily Monday–Friday, with occasional evenings or weekends for events and meetings.


Compensation

$70k–$80k commensurate with experience


Benefits

  • 403(b) Retirement Plan: Available after completing two years of service and meeting the plan's eligibility requirements, including 1,000 hours of service per year.
  • Paid Sick Leave: Earned in accordance with New Jersey law.
  • Health Insurance: Aetna medical coverage available after 90 days, subject to eligibility requirements. Employees also receive reimbursement for 90% of their health insurance deductible through OCA.
  • Dental & Vision Insurance: Guardian coverage available after 90 days, subject to eligibility requirements.

title: General Manager
description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

The Role

Must maintain onsite presence at assigned property during primary work hours and whenever business requirements necessitate it.
As a General Manager (GM) at Kasa, you will be fully responsible for the financial and operational performance of a single property, ranging from 100 to more than 300 rooms. This role demands a hands-on leader with strong operational expertise, direct P&L accountability, and the ability to balance partner relationships and guest experience expectations. The GM role is highly execution-focused, requiring deep engagement with onsite teams and property operations to ensure seamless service, operational efficiency, and financial success. You will spend approximately 95% of your time onsite, coaching teams, inspecting execution, and upholding a high bar for guest experience and operational standards.
At Kasa, hospitality is at the core of everything we do. As a GM, you will directly lead property-level teams, set expectations, inspect what you expect, and ensure every guest interaction meets Kasa’s high service standards. In addition to onsite leadership, you will play a critical role in financial oversight, aligning property operations with revenue optimization strategies, cost control initiatives, and, where appropriate, leasing activation plans.
You will work cross-functionally with Revenue Management, Finance, Marketing, People, and Guest Experience, ensuring that operational decisions align with financial objectives and broader business strategies. Additionally, you will serve as the primary liaison between Kasa and the property partner, communicating performance insights and forward-looking strategies to optimize asset value.
This role requires a balance of operational execution and strategic planning, with both executed with hospitality as a guiding throughline, to ensure the property operates efficiently, the team performs at a high level, and financial targets are met.

Key Responsibilites

Operational Execution & Hospitality Leadership

description:
Location: Lima, Peru

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Senior SAP Developer – ABAP & Fiori to join our IT team in Lima. This is a full-time, on-site position supporting the Global Center of Expertise (SAP Customer Competence Center), which provides development and support services for the centralized SAP system in Switzerland and various sites worldwide.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP ABAP development and SAP Fiori/UI5, with a solid understanding of SAP ERP integration and business processes. In this role, you will design, develop, maintain, and support solutions that enable business integration and process optimization across the organization. Advanced English communication skills are required.

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

· Design, development and testing of ABAP and OData backend developments.

· Design and build applications consistent with the SAP Fiori Application Architecture.

· Monitor, analyse, fine tune, and optimize business processes and interfaces.

· Propose and implement Procurement/MM & FI/CO business process improvements

· Work closely with internal customers to maintain the existing and to implement new solutions.

· Provide and Level support on a daily basis.

· Ensuring compliance with programming standards.

Candidates who would excel in our environment:

  • At least 7 years of ABAP and Fiori development experience.
  • Good knowledge of ABAP development in various areas (oData Services, CDS Views, Enhancements/BADIs, BAPIs, Workflow, Smartforms/Adobe forms, LSMW and ALE/IDOC).
  • Good Experience building SAP UI5 Apps, including Fiori Elements.
  • Proficient in ABAP OO Programming.
  • Experience working with latest SAP technologies such as ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and SAP BTP is considered as a plus.
  • S/4 HANA Upgrade experience is considered as a plus.
  • Track record of working in SAP ECC 6.0; S/4 HANA experience is considered a plus.
  • Good knowledge within FI/CO Module; knowledge in PS and MM module is considered as a plus.
  • Analytical perception, structured way of working with an ability to get things done.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong client relationship skills with the demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • Fluency in English (speaking, writing), as this is an English-speaking environment.

What We Offer:

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

- A dynamic and inclusive work environment.

- The chance to make a significant impact in a leading global company.

Who we are

Glencore is one of the world’s largest natural resources companies. Our operations comprise around 150 mining and metallurgical sites and oil production assets, employing 135,000 people directly and as contractors around the world.

Our Purpose is to responsibly source the commodities that advance everyday life. The products we source and market play an essential role in modern life. From the copper, cobalt and nickel powering the electric vehicle and renewable energy revolution, to the energy products helping us power this transition and keeping the lights on today– what we do touches every part of life as we know it.

The diversity of our portfolio underpins our strategic ambition to play a leading role in enabling the decarbonisation of global energy usage through providing metals such as copper, cobalt, zinc and nickel that are essential to the transition to a low-carbon economy. In a first for the mining and trading industry in addressing Climate Change, we launched a net zero total emissions ambition by 2050, which aligns our business strategy with the goals of the Paris Agreement.

Come and join us on our journey to a sustainable future.

description:
People First

implantcast – Shaping the future together.


As a reliable partner for physicians and patients, we develop and manufacture both standard and custom-made endoprostheses. More than 900 employees help ensure that people around the world can actively participate in life again with our products “Made in Germany” from Buxtehude near Hamburg. This meaningful mission fills us with pride – and perhaps soon you, too?


Your future responsibilities:


  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Manufacturing Engineering Teams
  • Analyse, kontinuierliche Optimierung und Standardisierung von Produktions- und Fertigungsprozessen hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz und Wirtschaftlichkeit.
  • Verantwortung für die Industrialisierung neuer Produkte und Prozesse sowie deren erfolgreiche Überführung in die Serienfertigung
  • Planung und Umsetzung von Investitions- und Optimierungsprojekten
  • Identifikation und nachhaltige Lösung technischer und organisatorischer Herausforderungen im Produktionsumfeld.
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen und Qualitätsstandards sowie validierter Produktionsprozesse im Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen (KVP)
  • Analyse relevanter Prozess- und Fertigungskennzahlen sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Qualitätssicherung, Forschung & Entwicklung sowie weiteren relevanten Schnittstellen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Industrialisierungs- und Optimierungsprojekten.
  • Aufbau und nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung der Engineering-Kompetenz im Team.



What you bring to the role:


  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften, beispielsweise Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Medizintechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Medizintechnik, idealerweise in Produktion, Industrialisierung, Fertigungstechnik oder Produktentwicklung.
  • Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik, idealerweise in der Herstellung von Implantaten oder anderen hochregulierten Medizinprodukten
  • Erfahrung in der Einführung und Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen sowie im Projektmanagement.
  • Führungserfahrung sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
  • Kenntnisse relevanter regulatorischer Anforderungen und Normen im Medizinprodukteumfeld, insbesondere MDR und ISO 13485.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, ausgeprägte Qualitätsorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Veränderungsprozesse erfolgreich zu gestalten.
  • Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


These are our benefits:

  • Fürstenberg Institute: confidential mental health coaching & individual counselling
  • Sports and health promotion allowance
  • ObstKINDERGarten childcare service
  • Bike leasing at attractive conditions
  • Company medical service with occupational healthcare support and vaccination offers
  • Employer contribution to company pension scheme
  • Subsidy for the Deutschland-Ticket
  • Holiday pay, Christmas bonus and anniversary payments
  • Corporate benefits with attractive employee discounts

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Plasma Center Technician
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

At BioLife, we know that flexibility matters—especially for those balancing multiple commitments. That's why we're dedicated to creating meaningful part-time opportunities for our team.


This role is truly part-time, with most shifts lasting between 4 to 6 hours a day, 3+ days per week—designed to fit your life.
• We’ll confirm your availability and shift days and times early in the interview process. And, because we value open communication, you’ll always be informed about any schedule changes in advance.
• Our patients depend on the plasma we collect, so your reliability during your scheduled hours is greatly valued. However, our part-time roles are designed with the understanding that flexibility on both sides is key.


Whether you’re looking for extra income, a way to gain valuable experience, or a schedule that fits your busy life—BioLife welcomes part-time team members just like you! Start strong with our paid, interactive training program!

This role requires that all individuals on the team hold one of the following current/active certifications: California Certified Phlebotomy Technician 1 License (CPT1), a California Certified Phlebotomy Technician 2 License (CPT2), a California Clinical Laboratory Scientist License (CLS), or a California Medical Laboratory Technician License (MLT).

Please take this virtual tour to get a sneak peek of one of our Plasma Donation Centers.

About the role:
Every day, the donors you meet will motivate you. The high-quality plasma you collect will become life-changing medicines. Here, a commitment to customer service and quality is expected. You will report to the Plasma Center Manager and will perform as a plasma donor screener and perform phlebotomy to support plasma center operations.

How you will contribute:
· You will answer phones, and greet and focus on our donors, while ensuring the safety of donors and our team.
· You will screen new and repeat donors and take and record donor vital signs and finger stick results.
· You will use our Donor Information System, prepare donor charts, maintain accurate records, and coordinate donor compensation.
· You will help identify operational opportunities for continuous improvement and initiate changes to center processes using company approved procedures.
· You will be there for our donors, which includes working a variety of shifts, Saturdays and Sundays, and holidays.

What you bring to Takeda:
· High school diploma or equivalent
· Ability to walk and/or stand for the entire work shift
· Will work evenings, weekends, and holidays
· Ability to lean, bend, stoop, crouch, and reach above shoulders and below knees
· Ability to lift to 5 lbs., and occasional lifting of materials up to 32 lbs. and rarely 50 lbs.
· Fine motor coordination, depth perception, and ability to hear equipment from a distance
· Because of potential exposure to bloodborne pathogens (risk level 1), 90% of work tasks require prolonged glove wear
· 1 or more years minimum experience working in a customer or patient facing role is helpful

· Current license or certification in the state where duties will be assigned: Certified Phlebotomy Technician 1 (CPT1), Certified Phlebotomy Technician 2 (CPT2), Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS), or Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT).



What Takeda can offer you:
Every day at Takeda, we feel good knowing that what we do helps improve the lives of patients with rare diseases. At BioLife, while you focus on our donors, we will support you. We offer a purpose you can believe in, a team you can count on, opportunities for career growth, and a comprehensive benefits program to include retirement benefits, medical/dental, family leave, disability insurance and more, all in a fast-paced, friendly environment.

More about us:
At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.
Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to provide Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. We are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices.

title: Student Success & Career Coach
description:
LACKAWANNA COLLEGE HAS BEEN VOTED ONE OF THE

“BEST PLACES TO WORK IN PA” FOR 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2023 and 2024!

Lackawanna College is a private, accredited college serving the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania. Our main campus is located in downtown Scranton, and our footprint includes satellite centers in Covington Twp., Hawley, Hazleton, Sunbury, Towanda, Tunkhannock, Bethlehem, Chambersburg, and Greensburg.

Our mission is to provide a quality education to all persons who seek to improve their lives and better the communities in which they live. We provide our students with a direct path to a bachelor’s degree, associate degree, or one of many different professional certifications. Additionally, our Continuing Education department helps put the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania back to work with modern career skills. Lackawanna is also one of the most cost-efficient regional higher education institutions.

If our mission inspires you, and you are willing to go the extra mile to help our students succeed, please feel free to apply for this or future employment opportunities for which you meet the minimum qualifications. Please know that only the candidates who meet the minimum qualifications can be considered, and only those selected for interviews will be contacted by a college representative. No phone calls, please.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND OBJECTIVES:

Perkins Related Functions (50%): To provide associate level students with services necessary to ensure continued enrollment of career and technical education students and facilitate their transition from school to work through career counselling and internship placement. Provide mentoring and advising to associate-level students to help increase persistence and retention.

Non-Perkins Related Functions (50%): To expand relationships between secondary schools and Lackawanna College as well as recruiting students from those schools into pre-college programs by providing awareness of the opportunities available. This position will also advise and mentor students participating in pre-college programs to increase college and career readiness for a successful transition into undergraduate degrees.

*This is a full-time, grant-funded position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Perkins Related Functions (50%)To associate level CTE students:
  1. Provide career development, networking strategies, interviewing, résumé and cover letter writing skills, portfolio development and using the Internet for career search.
  2. Provide students with guidance and information regarding career research, options and decision making, goal setting, job searching, and school application process through coaching appointments and consultations.
  3. Provide presentations at open houses, academic orientations, and career week events, and help coordinate informational panels for capstone courses.
  4. Conduct walk‐in hours and workshops to promote experiential learning and assist students with internship search strategies, application materials, and academic/career skills.
  5. Attend job fairs and school career fairs as needed.
  6. Mentor pre-college students to improve the likelihood of post-secondary matriculation and successful transition to degree programs.
  7. Advise new and returning students in registration for courses
  8. Serves as academic advisor and assist with freshman scheduling for students in CTE-related majors with a focus on those identified as at-risk and special population/disability.
  9. Address all initial inquiries about internships from students, community organizations, faculty, parents, and alumni.
  10. Coordinate placement of students in business work positions including soliciting requests from supervisors, and providing student employment information, paperwork, and authorization to students.
  11. Update and maintain a Career and Internship Services website.
EITC 50% To high school and pre-college students:
  1. Lead and coordinate initiatives that enhance college readiness for pre-college students, including academic boot camps, early placement testing, and transition programming aligned with postsecondary expectations.
  2. Develop and deliver targeted outreach and presentations to prospective students and families to promote early college credit opportunities and increase program enrollment.
  3. Serve as a cross-functional liaison between Enrollment, Advising, Financial Aid, and Academic Affairs to ensure pre-college students complete all onboarding and enrollment requirements.
  4. Advise and support new and returning pre-college students with course registration, academic planning, and navigation of college systems.
  5. Facilitate the transition from pre-college to undergraduate enrollment, monitoring and supporting student conversion to degree-seeking status.
  6. Provide holistic mentorship and success coaching to pre-college students to improve persistence, academic performance, and postsecondary matriculation.
  7. Serve as a liaison between secondary and postsecondary partners to align expectations, strengthen college readiness, and support seamless student transitions.
  8. Coordinate early alert and intervention strategies, partnering with faculty and staff to identify at-risk students and implement timely support plans.
  9. Deliver career readiness programming, including résumé and cover letter development, interviewing skills, networking strategies, portfolio development, and career exploration using digital tools.
  10. Facilitate College 101/201 and related transition seminars focused on academic success, career pathways, and college navigation skills.
  11. Works during high impact periods, which include, but are not limited to: annual forum, graduation, orientations, week prior to the start of each semester, first two weeks of the semester, last two weeks of the semester prior to finals and advising periods.
  12. Other duties as assigned.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  1. Computer proficient in Excel and Word.
  2. Excellent verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills.
  3. Awareness of the local job market and skills necessary to secure employment.
  4. Some evening and weekends required.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College in related field. Masters preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Preferred experience in vocational counseling
  • Experience with Job Development/Internships preferred.
  • Experience in teaching, presenting workshops and/or providing counseling in an academic setting highly desirable.

Applications will only be accepted via online method by clicking the link below. Deadline for applications is December 4, 2026. No phone calls, please.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Builder Platform
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior Software Engineer - (Full Stack)

Okta Workflows is the secure, no-code automation platform that empowers organizations to build identity-centric workflows across cloud applications — all without writing code. Our intuitive drag-and-drop interface allows enterprises to automate complex business processes at scale, enhancing productivity, enforcing security, and simplifying IT operations.
Customers like Netflix, MGM, and NTT rely on Workflows to automate high-impact identity scenarios with speed and confidence.

As we continue to scale, we’re investing in extensibility, developer experience, and performance. Join us to help shape the future of cloud automation and low-code development.

Position Description

We’re hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join the Builder Platform team within Okta Workflows. This team is responsible for delivering the design-time Integrated Development Environment (IDE) which allows customers to create and manage Workflows, as well as design-time Flow management features and RBAC.

As a Senior Engineer, you’ll deliver initiatives that span front-end and back-end services — delivering performant, secure, and scalable features. You’ll help drive technical design, lead implementation, and collaborate closely with Design, PM, and Platform teams. You’ll also work directly with our technical architects to help shape what we build — and how we build it. This is a high-impact role in a growing, strategic product area with strong executive visibility.

Role Details:

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end features using modern JavaScript and cloud-native technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL).
  • Drive technical design for key initiatives, driving quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Build reusable and performant UI components and services for our design-time IDE experience, flow management, and RBAC.
  • Own services throughout their lifecycle — including implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and incident response.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, and Architecture to define the “what” and “how” of features, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and technically sound.
  • Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to optimize system performance and reliability.
  • Mentor and support engineers across the team, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to cross-functional planning, architectural reviews, and team-wide engineering practices.

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience building modern web applications in a full-stack environment.
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, ReactJS, and Node.js (Express or similar frameworks).
  • Experience designing APIs, working with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), and building services in a distributed, cloud-based architecture.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity or experience with access control models (RBAC) or complex application state/flow management.
  • A strong product mindset — you work well with Product and Design and care about delivering intuitive and elegant user experiences.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with Architects to make smart technical tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams.
  • Passion for craftsmanship and high engineering standards (testing, monitoring, documentation, scalability).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and build consensus across functions.
  • A growth mindset and interest in mentoring others and upleveling the team.

Nice to Haves:

  • Exposure to low-code/no-code tools, workflow engines, visual development platforms, or web-based IDEs.
  • Interest in AI-assisted developer tooling or automation.

Education and Training:

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, or relevant industry experience

title: Video Editor
description:
ECOG Core Technologies is looking for a Video Editor to join its Digital team. You will turn raw footage into social media videos, product demos and promotional content for company and client campaigns.

Roles & Responsibilities
• Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos from briefs, scripts and raw footage.
• Select takes, build sequences and refine pacing to tell a clear story.
• Add captions, titles, transitions and simple motion graphics that follow brand guidelines.
• Clean up audio, balance music and dialogue, and apply basic color correction.
• Export and review videos in the right aspect ratios and formats for each platform.
• Coordinate with content creators and designers, incorporate feedback and keep project files organized.

Requirements

• Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or a comparable editing tool.
• Understanding of video pacing, captions, basic audio editing and color correction.
• Ability to follow a creative brief, manage revisions and meet deadlines.
• Share a portfolio, show reel or sample edits if available.
• Motion graphics or Adobe After Effects experience is helpful.

title: Deep Foundation Testing Technician
description:
Tolunay-Wong Engineers, Inc. (TWE) is seeking applicants for a Deep Foundations Testing Technician in our Beaumont Geotechnical Division, based out of Beaumont, Texas. This full-time position encompasses a wide range of testing, monitoring, and inspection of various deep foundations and also supports our geotechnical and geophysical service lines. All necessary training for the position is provided; experienced and inexperienced candidates are welcome to apply. Please note this is both a labor intensive and technical job. Candidates must be physically able to perform tasks such as loading and unloading test equipment from a vehicle or trailer, lifting and working with objects at grade, or working from heights (manlift). Candidates must demonstrate clear communication skills both with internal staff and clients/construction staff, attention to detail both in technical procedures and written documentation, and technical acuity with regards to using hand tools, instruments, and computer software.

The position requires frequent travel as our department provides Deep Foundations Testing Services for the entire Gulf Coast region and nationally. Each out-of-town deployment can be as short as a single day or last up to two weeks. Daily schedules follow project construction scheduled work hours dictated by the client or EPC.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate with field personnel and perform or assist with deep foundation testing. Deep Foundations Testing services include the following:
    • Installation Monitoring and Pile Instrumentation
    • Vibration Monitoring
    • High-Strain Dynamic Pile Load Testing (PDA)
    • Static Pile Load Testing (SLT)
    • Low-Strain Pile Integrity Testing (PIT)
    • Sonic Logging (SSL/CSL)
    • Thermal Integrity Profiling (TIP)
  • Perform field testing assignments scheduled by the Project Coordinator/Project Manager.
  • Complete all required paperwork, including daily reports, safety paperwork, and vehicle & equipment inspections.
  • Installing strain gauges, accelerometers and access tubes.
  • Caring for, charging and calibration-checking test equipment.
  • Working directly with contractor superintendents and pile crews.
  • Reporting field observations and preliminary results to the PM.
  • Attend all safety meetings and comply with both TWE and client safety standards and programs.
  • Maintain a clean and organized working environment, including work vehicle, equipment and job site areas.
  • Maintain a clean and professional appearance.
  • Turn in all required paperwork to office on a daily basis.
  • Tabulate recorded information using Microsoft Excel.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum Age of 21
  • Able to read and write in English.
  • Able to pass a background check.
  • Willing to travel on short notice.
  • Able to pass an initial, random, and annual hair follicle drug test.
  • Hold a valid Driver’s License and maintain a clean driving record.
  • Able to physically implement work duties (such as lifting 40-lbs, assembling test equipment, working from heights) assigned in various weather elements.
  • Willing to work diligently and take ownership over work whether project is small or large.
  • Able to facilitate positive, professional customer relations.
  • Willing to learn, ask questions, and offer new ideas and suggestions.
  • High-School diploma or GED
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Current Safety Essentials (Previously Basic Plus / Safety Essentials Orientation).
  • Current TWIC card.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Excel.
  • Engineering coursework or degree (Civil, Geotechnical, Mechanical) or prior deep foundation testing experience
  • PDCA Dynamic Measurement and Analysis Proficiency Test (Provisional rank or better).

BENEFITS

TWE provides its full-time employees with a benefit package that is inclusive of the following:

  • Work vehicle provided for all field related duties
  • Mileage reimbursement for personal vehicle use while on company business
  • $45/day per diem for out-of-town project work
  • $75 Monthly mobile phone allowance
  • Health Insurance with an option for HSA with matching contributions
  • Vision Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Long-Term Disability
  • Life Insurance (Individual $50,000 coverage is 100% paid by TWE)
  • Catastrophic Accident Insurance (Individual $50,000 coverage is 100% paid by TWE)
  • Colonial Life Supplemental Benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Program with up to 3% employer match (eligible after 180 days).
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 120 hours of Paid Time Off (PTO) annually
  • 9 company paid holidays

TWE is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Retail Merchandise Processor at Loveland
description:
Ohio Valley Goodwill Industries, founded in 1916, is one of the largest providers of rehabilitation services in the State of Ohio. Utilizing our retail store network, we generate sales revenue to support thousands of individuals with disabilities and homeless local veterans.

The Retail Merchandise Processor will partner with production and retail team members in a high energy fast-paced environment to perform a variety of operational functions that include receiving, sorting, pricing, processing and preparing donated merchandise to display for sale in a Goodwill retail store.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED:
This position does not have supervisory responsibilities

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Work a flexible schedule in support of the store opening, production, and closing operations including work on weekends and holidays.
  • A minimum of six months of previous work experience, or the equivalent educational or vocational experience preferred.
  • Must be able to follow directions well and communicate effectively in English
  • Ability to problem solve.
  • Ability to provide exceptional customer service to all our customers in a friendly and engaging way.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled environment.
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 35 pounds at times.
  • Ability to perform continuous walking, stooping, standing, bending, kneeling and climbing for prolonged periods of time (up to 7 hours per 8 hour shift).
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to airborne particles.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Sort and process soft and hard line merchandise from containers to determine appropriateness for the sales floor in accordance with established guidelines.
  • Roll merchandise and accurately stock on sales floor.
  • Accurately and timely record and monitor donations.
  • Stay abreast of brand name, designer labels, current and vintage styles.
  • Sort apparel into boutique/Ecommerce, sellable, and salvage categories according to quota.
  • Place items on hangers, places hangers on rolling rack, and transport them to the sales floor keeping similar items grouped.
  • Maintain a pace at which one is able to meet daily quota for pieces processed.
  • Price and roll merchandise to sales floor to their appropriate areas in a well-organized/merchandised manner
  • Comply with safety and security practices including reporting safety hazards and injuries to the manager on duty.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to all our donors/customers, including friendly and engaging interactions.
  • Comply with all policies, including participating in store meetings and trainings.
  • Adhere to work schedule set by supervisor.
  • Maintain a clean, safe and organized work environment, including production area.
  • Maintain a professional appearance adhering to Goodwill uniform standards.
  • Communicate Goodwill’s mission and vision effectively to our donors and customers.
  • Cross train as necessary in other functions of store operations and assist as needed in other areas of the store.
  • Other duties as assigned.

If you’re looking for a rewarding, fulfilling experience, please join our team!!
Please complete application and attach resume with detailed work experience. Incomplete applications will not be considered for the position.

Payrate: $13.00 per hour

Internal employees can earn a $500 referral bonus by referring a candidate who is hired and completes 90 days of employment. To ensure you receive credit for your referral, please have the candidate include your full name on their application. Start referring today!

title: Location Head - Real Estate Financing
description:
About the Opportunity:

A senior leadership opportunity to lead the Bengaluru business of a growing real estate financing and investment advisory platform.

The role is suited to a commercially driven professional with a strong track record in real estate lending/financing, established developer and market relationships, and the ability to originate, structure, negotiate and close transactions.

The Location Head will own regional business development and revenue growth, lead the origination team, and build a strong and profitable transaction pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

- Business Development & Deal Origination: Drive regional business development and revenue growth by sourcing and originating real estate financing opportunities, including developer/project financing, debt syndication, land-related financing/intermediation and other structured real estate funding solutions.

- Build and expand relationships with real estate developers, investors, lenders, banks, NBFCs, AIFs/funds and other key market participants.

- Identify target clients and markets, develop a clear view of the regional opportunity universe, and convert relationships into mandates.

- Transaction Leadership & Execution: Lead transactions end to end - from origination and mandate development through credit/investment assessment, structuring, due diligence, negotiation and closure.

- Guide the preparation and review of information memoranda, pitch books, investment presentations, financial models, business plans, project cash-flow analysis and micro-market assessments.

- Oversee transaction documentation and diligence, resolve key commercial issues, and negotiate transaction terms with clients, investors, lenders and other stakeholders.

- Team Leadership & Business Ownership: Lead, mentor and develop the origination team, setting clear priorities and driving accountability for pipeline development, execution and outcomes.

- Take ownership of the Bengaluru region's business performance, with a focus on revenue generation, portfolio development and profitable growth.

- Work closely with senior leadership to strengthen execution capabilities, scale the regional business and support the platform's growth plans.

- Client Relationships & Market Intelligence: Act as the senior point of contact for key developer, client and investor relationships, ensuring strong relationship continuity throughout the transaction lifecycle.

- Maintain an informed view of Bengaluru's real estate markets, wholesale funding trends, competing capital providers and local market developments.

- Track market intelligence and maintain relevant databases to identify emerging opportunities, assess risks and refine business development priorities.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

- 12 - 16 years of relevant experience in real estate financing/lending within a bank, NBFC or AIF/fund. Candidates from SME or mid-market banking/NBFC lending may also be considered, provided they have strong origination and transaction experience.

- Management qualification from a Category A institute.

- Demonstrated experience in deal origination, client acquisition, transaction structuring, negotiations and end-to-end deal execution.

- A strong network across the Bengaluru real estate ecosystem and/or relevant lending, investment and mid-market business communities.

- Proven ability to lead teams, manage senior stakeholders and deliver business growth in a fast-paced, competitive environment.

- Strong commercial judgement, analytical ability, interpersonal skills and organisational capability.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and navigate complex or conflicting stakeholder situations.

- Knowledge of local languages will be an advantage.

What the Role Offers:

- Regional business ownership, with the opportunity to build and grow the Bengaluru business.

- A broader role in transaction-led real estate financing and investment advisory, with exposure beyond conventional direct lending.

- A relatively flat, entrepreneurial environment with close access to senior leadership and room to take ownership.

- The opportunity to contribute directly to business growth and take on wider responsibilities as the platform scales.

Commercial Real Estate Lending experience preferred:

Location:

Bengaluru, India

title: ICT Trainer cum Executive (Primary School | Marine Parade / Tanjong Katong)
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced ICT Trainer cum Executive to be deployed at a reputable primary school in the East. You will play a key role in supporting the school's ICT programmes, empowering teachers with EdTech tools, managing multimedia projects, and guiding students in digital literacy in alignment with MOE's EdTech Masterplan 2030.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technology & Classroom Support: Provide timely ICT support for teachers and students during technology-based lessons and school-based programmes (such as recess activities).
  • Professional Training for Teachers: Design and facilitate practical workshops to build teachers' EdTech capabilities across multimedia creation (PowerPoint, Canva, podcasting, green screen video production), emerging EdTech (gamification, generative AI, productivity apps), and reusable digital resource curation.
  • School-Based ICT & Multimedia Projects: Provide advisory and technical expertise for creative works, handle photography for official school events, and produce video montages and photo collages.
  • Cybersecurity & Digital Literacy: Guide students on safe and responsible technology use, and collaborate with the HOD ICT and ICT Level Reps to implement the school's digital literacy and technological skills plan.
  • Technical & Asset Management: Assist the HOD ICT in managing school technology infrastructure, tracking ICT assets, coordinating preventive maintenance schedules, and conducting regular inventory checks.
  • Other Duties: Undertake any other ICT- and multimedia-related tasks as assigned by the school.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Qualifications: Possess a relevant ICT/IT qualification from a recognized institution, or an equivalent qualification.
  • IT Administration Experience: At least 3 years of experience in the administration, skills, and ability to use relevant IT systems within the last 3 years.
  • Primary School Training Experience: At least 3 years of experience in sharing ICT-related skills in primary school settings within the last 3 years.

description:

Support

Job Description:

This position is subject to the terms of Appendix D in the Full-Time Support Staff Collective Agreement.


Note: 1 vacancy available. This position is deemed a critical vacancy.

Payband: This position is paid at Payband G. $35.29 - $40.73 per hour.


Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.


Why this Role is Important

The incumbent reports to the Manager, Admissions. The incumbent is responsible for the administration related to the admission, registration and graduation of students. In order to achieve this, the incumbent is required to make decisions, participate in communicating a wide variety of information, maintaining detailed academic records and processing applications from www.ontariocolleges.ca or our international Virtual Application System (VAS). The incumbent is a subject specialist on admissions assessments, registration, and student record progression. They play a key role in the promotion of goodwill between the college community and our students. They must ensure that all possible assistance is provided to students to facilitate their education and future employment.


How You’ll Make an Impact

Admissions, Registration and Progression

  • Responds to inquiries from students internal and external to the College Community, in compliance with the regulations of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA).
  • Processing application for admission for all full-time and part-time programs ensuring that inquiries are responded to and decisions are conveyed, in a timely manner.
