title: Principle Safety and Assurance Business Partner
description:
Together, we move what matters

We are at the start of something powerful. Heavy Haul Rail was created with a simple but transformative belief: the UK deserves a smarter, cleaner, more resilient freight future. And we have the opportunity to build it.

Every role in this business carries purpose. Whether you work in operational delivery, driving trains, engineering, or business support, the work you do contributes directly to reducing emissions, easing road congestion, strengthening supply chains and powering British industry. This is meaningful work, with real impact.

Who we are

Previously operating as Freightliner’s Heavy Haul business, we are now an independent company following CMA CGM Group’s acquisition of Freightliner UK’s Intermodal Logistics business in January 2026.

Heavy Haul Rail is the UK’s next-generation rail freight partner built for a sector ready to evolve. We believe it’s time to move differently. Congested roads, rising emissions, fragile supply chains. These aren’t just logistical challenges; they’re environmental and economic wake-up calls. We’re here to lead the modal shift, helping businesses transition from road to rail with confidence, clarity, and measurable impact.

We move 17 million tonnes of freight a year for customers in the industrial, energy and construction markets. The company operates 95 locomotives and over 1000 wagons. Heavy Haul Rail’s team of 950 supports customer deliveries to over 100 locations across the UK, running 250 trains per week.

Heavy Haul Rail also supports the renewal and maintenance of the rail infrastructure and supports passenger train operators and rolling stock companies, including the provision of drivers and route conducting services.

But none of this happens without us, its people.

Role Profile


Job Title: Principle Safety and Assurance Business Partner


Who we are

Heavy Haul Rail (HHR) is the UK’s next-generation rail freight partner built for a sector ready to evolve. We believe it’s time to move differently. Congested roads, rising emissions, fragile supply chains. These aren’t just logistical challenges; they’re environmental and economic wake-up calls. We’re here to lead the modal shift, helping businesses transition from road to rail with confidence, clarity, and measurable impact.

We move 17 million tonnes of freight a year for customers in the industrial, energy and construction markets. The company operates 95 locomotives and over 1000 wagons. HHR’s team of 950 supports customer deliveries to over 100 locations across the UK, running 250 trains per week.

HHR also supports the renewal and maintenance of the rail infrastructure and supports passenger train operators and rolling stock companies, including the provision of drivers and route conducting services.


The Purpose of Your Role

You will lead the development of a robust evidence led and industry leading safety strategy that will underpin and enable growth and expansion of our business. You will also develop, lead and champion a programme that will place proportionate and effective safety at the heart of everything we do. You will oversee effective delivery through suppliers, service partners and internal functions, gathering and utilising high quality management information to drive ongoing continual improvement.

You will champion effective and proportionate management of safety, act as an expert adviser and critical friend to the leadership team, management and staff, and engage in leading and developing the health and safety capability within to increase reach across the business. You will also represent the company with external stakeholders including industry groups, regulators, and government. In achieving this you will do so by aligning with HHR’s vision: to become the UK’s most progressive and powerful rail freight partner.

  • This role is pivotal in delivering smarter, cleaner, and more connected freight solutions, embodying our values:

  • Make every mile matter
  • Build boldly
  • Move as one
  • Deliver with certainty
  • Fuel the future.


What You’ll Do

1. Drive accountability for effective and legally compliant Health, Safety and Environmental management systems.

2. Lead in the development and delivery of a risk-based assurance plan to provide the business awareness of regulatory and heath and safety compliance.

3. Champion the competence and assurance agenda, and provide advice, support and guidance to internal stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of improvement plans and projects throughout the business.

4. Provide advice guidance and direction to ensure effective remedial action following accidents, operational incidents and precursor incidents.

5. Lead and develop the business capability for training, competence and assurance to provide high quality, professional, business focussed support in every part of our organisation.

6. Collaborate with the Leadership Team to develop a business focussed safety strategy for the organisation, together with a high level, output focussed delivery plan.

7. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop comprehensive and high-quality management information to support effective targeting and decision making, together with comprehensive metrics to measure effectiveness, performance and benefits realisation.

8. Facilitate development of ambitious delivery/improvement plans in each area of the business, to include upskilling internal stakeholders to obtain effective engagement.

9. Champion the safety agenda, and provide advice, support and guidance to internal stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of improvement plans and projects throughout the business.

10. Lead and develop the health and safety team to provide high quality, professional, business focussed support in every part of our organisation

11. Develop monthly reports including KPIs to illustrate key trends and inform strategy and planning within the business

12. Lead on interaction with Regulatory Bodies, industry groups and external stakeholders

13. Maintain up to date knowledge of legislation and best practice relating to health and safety, and engage actively in CPD as prescribed by professional body

14. Other tasks as required by the business

What We’re Looking For

1. Level 6 or 7 qualification in a relevant subject or equivalent vocational experience

2. Membership of a relevant professional body

3. Experience of leading safety, competence management, training or assurance, ideally within the rail, transport or similar high hazard sector.

4. Excellent written and oral communication skills.

5. The ability to produce clear and concise written documentation and to present technical detail in a concise, engaging and business focussed manner

6. Excellent influencing skills and the ability to engage others in a shared objective

7. Ability to prioritise workload and use experience and initiative to engage internal and external stakeholders

8. Willingness and ability to work flexibly and travel throughout the UK with occasional overnight stays

9. Be competent in the use of computers including Microsoft 365 suite and relevant specialist software, as well as intranet, social media and other sharing applications

Your Behaviours

1. Attacks tasks and objectives with drive, energy and enthusiasm;

2. Rolls their sleeves up and gets involved in a wide variety of tasks and activities;

3. Demonstrates a “can do” attitude and is seen as an ambassador for the Company;

4. Proactive approach to work and uses own initiative to implement process improvements;

5. Embraces new challenges and gets things done;

6. Sets high standards of work for self and consistently achieves these;

7. Seen as friendly and approachable, always willing to assist and get involved;

8. Good team player;

Why Join Us?

Here, you’re not one small part of a big machine. You’re a key contributor with national significance and real-world impact. We want our colleagues to feel proud of the work they do, connected to our mission and empowered to shape the future of this business. As part of Heavy Haul Rail, you can expect:

  • Purpose that matters. Your work contributes to a cleaner, more efficient freight industry.

  • Opportunity to shape what’s next. We’re new, agile and ready to do things differently, your ideas help build our future.

  • A team that moves forward together. Collaboration, respect and shared ambition define how we work.

  • A commitment to excellence. We deliver with pride, precision and professionalism.

  • Room to grow. Your development fuels our momentum.

Our perks and benefits

Our people are our most important asset. We strive to empower our employees, ensuring they are trained and competent, fit for work, always informed, and completely engaged in our culture that places safety and wellbeing firmly at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for the most committed and reliable individuals who possess the knowledge, skills and experience needed for their roles. In return we can offer considerable career progression, and a rewarding career in an award-winning team alongside:

  • Competitive pay

  • Fantastic final-salary pension scheme after an initial qualifying period

  • Enhanced maternity & paternity pay

  • Opportunities for ongoing training and development.

  • Access to the company's life assurance scheme

  • A range of benefits to make your own so you can get the most of your work and home life which will also help save you money and hassle. From reimbursement on health treatments, to savings on new cars.

Apply now

We know where we’re heading. We know why it matters. Now, it’s time to move, to make it real, together.

For queries contact careers@heavyhaulrail.co.uk

Shaping tomorrow. Starting today

The future we want to build won’t happen on its own, we have to move it forward, together. Heavy Haul Rail has the purpose, the ambition and the opportunity to reshape how Britain moves. Whatever our roles, we are collaborators, creators and custodians of a better future. This journey starts with what we choose to do today, tomorrow and every day after that.

Our values are:

  • Make Every Mile Matter: We act with intention and responsibility, knowing our work shapes a cleaner, stronger future for the UK.

  • Build Boldly: We use our entrepreneurial spirit to challenge legacy thinking and design better ways forward, for our customers, our industry and each other.

  • We move as one: We collaborate with trust, respect and shared momentum, because progress is a team sport.

  • Deliver with certainty: We stand behind our work. We’re reliable, precise and accountable in everything we do.

  • Fuelling The Future: We invest in our people and our potential, championing learning, curiosity and continuous improvement. with confidence, clarity, and measurable impact.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Enterprise Platform
description:
About F5:

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. Everything we do centers around people.

Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - Platform

F5 is the global leader in delivering and securing every app and API. Trusted by Global Fortune 500 companies, F5 keeps applications and APIs fast, available, and secure across the complex hybrid multicloud environments where modern digital business operates. Through the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP), F5 converges application delivery and security to reduce complexity, strengthen resilience, and protect digital experiences at scale.

About the Position:

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our ADSP - F5 Connector program team in Bangalore. The F5 Connector is a critical architectural component of the ADSP - it provides the bridge between customer on-premises and cloud-deployed infrastructure and F5's cloud-native SaaS services. As a Principal Engineer, you will own the architecture, performance, and reliability of the connector's data plane and control plane. This is a high-performance, systems-level role requiring deep expertise in Rust / C++ to build software that operates at massive scale.

Roles and Responsibilities:

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering in a fast-paced environment with most recent 3+ years as Architect or Principal Engineer with ability to architect & design large scale enterprise class platforms in microservice based solution and architectural style.

- Hands-on coding in Rust / C++, be able to conceptualize and develop prototype quickly.

- Drive technical roadmap of the team in collaboration with Engineering and Product.

- Leverage AI to write code that adheres to the requirements, is cost-effective and maintainable.

- Familiarity with the OpenTelemetry Arrow Protocol (OTAP) for efficient, columnar-encoded transport of telemetry data.

- Grasp of bi-directional (bidi) streaming via gRPC, including flow control, multiplexed streams, back-pressure handling, and long-lived connection management.

- Added plus: Experience with Apache Arrow columnar memory format.

- Own the end-to-end architecture of the F5 Connector, encompassing the data plane and control plane.

- Mentor senior and junior engineers across Bangalore and global teams; Perform code reviews, set coding practices and guidelines within the team.

- Experience working with all the phases of a development cycle for a software product.

- Work with geographically distributed teams.

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.


We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices?     • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design

title: Inventory Assistant
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite)
Department: Inventory / Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: Operations In-Charge

Job Summary
We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Inventory Assistant to manage daily store operations, inventory records, stock movements, billing activities, and related documentation.

The candidate will maintain accurate stock records, verify incoming and outgoing materials, prepare invoices, and coordinate with Accounts, Sales, Purchase, and Dispatch. The ideal candidate should have good organizational skills, basic computer knowledge, numerical accuracy, and the ability to maintain systematic inventory and billing records.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Stock and Inventory Management
• Maintain accurate and updated stock records in the inventory system, Excel, or stock register.
• Record all stock inward and outward transactions promptly.
• Verify received materials against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans.
• Ensure materials are issued only against authorized requests or approved documents.
• Monitor stock availability and identify low-stock items.
• Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
• Maintain records of damaged, returned, rejected, and excess materials.
• Ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and organization of materials.

B. Billing and Invoice Management
• Prepare sales bills and invoices using the company's billing software.
• Verify product details, quantities, prices, customer information, and applicable taxes.
• Ensure billing records match the actual materials supplied.
• Prepare delivery challans and other dispatch-related documents.
• Maintain invoice records and supporting documentation.
• Coordinate with the Accounts team to resolve billing discrepancies.
• Ensure all billing transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

C. Goods Receipt and Dispatch Coordination
• Receive materials from suppliers and verify quantity and condition.
• Prepare and maintain Goods Received Notes (GRNs), wherever applicable.
• Coordinate with the Sales and Dispatch teams for timely material movement.
• Verify materials before dispatch and ensure the correct quantity is issued.
• Maintain records of deliveries, returns, replacements, and material transfers.
• Report shortages, damaged goods, and discrepancies to the reporting manager.

D. Documentation and Reporting
• Maintain purchase invoices, sales bills, stock registers, delivery challans, and other store documents.
• Prepare daily stock inward and outward reports.
• Maintain daily billing summaries and closing stock reports.
• Prepare low-stock reports and communicate replenishment requirements.
• Maintain accurate digital and physical records for audits and management reviews.
• Submit daily and periodic reports within the prescribed timelines.

E. Store Maintenance and Coordination
• Keep the store clean, organized, and properly maintained.
• Ensure materials are stored safely and can be easily identified and retrieved.
• Coordinate with the Purchase team regarding pending supplies and replenishment requirements.
• Support the Accounts team with billing records and supporting documents.
• Communicate stock availability and dispatch status to relevant departments.
• Follow company procedures for inventory control, billing, documentation, and material handling.

Expected Outcomes
• Accurate and updated inventory records.
• Error-free billing and proper invoice documentation.
• Controlled and traceable stock movements.
• Timely identification of stock shortages and discrepancies.
• Organized store operations and reliable reporting.
• Smooth coordination between Inventory, Accounts, Sales, Purchase, and Dispatch teams.

Working Hours
8:50 AM to 6:30 PM

Requirements

Experience Required: 0–3 Years

Required Qualifications
• Any undergraduate degree.
• 1–3 years of experience in store keeping, inventory management, billing, or warehouse operations is preferred.
• Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Excel.
• Knowledge of invoice preparation, stock registers, and delivery documentation.
• Familiarity with inventory or billing software is an added advantage.

Required Skills
• Good numerical ability and attention to detail.
• Strong organizational and record-maintenance skills.
• Ability to maintain accurate stock and billing records.
• Good communication and coordination skills.
• Time management and task prioritization.
• Ability to identify and report stock discrepancies.
• Responsible, honest, punctual, and systematic approach to work.
• Ability to coordinate with multiple departments.

Preferred Candidate
• Immediate joiners preferred.
• Candidates based in or willing to work from Coimbatore.
• Candidates with practical experience in inventory, billing, and store operations.
• Candidates with good documentation and stock-handling abilities.

Benefits

• Full-time employment.
• Salary based on experience and skill set.
• Professional growth and career development opportunities.
• Opportunity to work in a structured operations environment.
• Exposure to inventory management, billing, and business operations.

title: Senior Manager - Digital Media
description:
Job Description:

1. Role Purpose:

The Senior Manager - Digital Media leads the external media team for Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with a dual mandate of strengthening brand consideration and driving customer acquisition.

This is a hands-on team leadership role, combining direct ownership of priority media work with oversight of team delivery and performance.

The role owns digital media strategy, planning, execution and optimisation across paid channels, ensuring that both personally managed initiatives and team-led campaigns deliver against clearly defined marketing and business objectives.

The incumbent will lead two manager-level direct reports and one Media Analyst, set priorities and review their work, while managing digital media agencies and partners.

The role will recommend deployment of approved budgets across channels and campaigns and continuously improve media effectiveness based on performance.

The role must connect digital media activity with downstream business outcomes by maintaining visibility across the customer funnel: impressions and reach, traffic, leads, applications, conversions and disbursals.

Working with relevant internal teams, the incumbent will use this visibility to understand performance and identify improvements across the funnel.

The immediate scope is Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with the potential for the role to progressively support the broader Muthoot FinCorp digital media mandate.

Key Accountabilities:

A. Digital Media Strategy:

- Translate brand and business objectives into integrated digital media strategies.

- Define the appropriate combination of channels, audiences, formats and campaign objectives.

- Develop media strategies across Google, Meta, programmatic, online video and other relevant paid digital channels.

- Balance investments between brand-building and customer-acquisition objectives.

- Identify emerging digital media opportunities and recommend their application to Muthoot FinCorp ONE.

- Outcome: A clearly defined digital media strategy that delivers both brand impact and customer acquisition.

B. Digital Brand Building:

- Develop paid media strategies for key brand and product campaigns.

- Build audience strategies designed to deliver effective reach and frequency amongst priority customer segments.

- Partner with Brand and Content teams to ensure creative ideas are effectively translated into digital media.

- Drive amplification of key campaigns across relevant digital platforms.

- Track indicators such as reach, frequency, engagement, video consumption, branded search and consideration.

- Outcome: Sustained improvement in Muthoot FinCorp ONE's visibility and consideration amongst priority customer audiences.

C. Customer Acquisition:

- Plan and manage acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, video, affiliates and other relevant digital channels.

- Drive traffic, leads, journey initiations and applications for priority Muthoot FinCorp ONE propositions.

- Continuously optimise campaigns across audiences, creatives, placements, platforms and bidding strategies.

- Balance acquisition volumes with lead quality, conversion and cost efficiency.

- Build effective prospecting and conversion campaign structures.

- Outcome: Scalable and cost-efficient acquisition of customers with demonstrable contribution to business volumes.

D. Full-Funnel Media Effectiveness:

- Define appropriate KPIs across each stage of the funnel.

- Track media-generated customers through downstream business outcomes.

- Work with Business, Product and Analytics teams to understand lead quality and conversion.

- Identify significant funnel drop-offs and determine whether interventions are required across media, audience, communication or customer journeys.

- Use downstream conversion information to improve future media decisions.

- Build a clear understanding of digital media's contribution to customer acquisition and disbursals.

- Outcome: Media decisions increasingly optimised against business outcomes rather than platform-level metrics alone.

E. Media Planning and Investment Management:

- Develop annual, quarterly and campaign-level digital media plans.

- Recommend allocation of approved budgets across platforms, campaigns and objectives.

- Recommend reallocation of spends based on campaign performance and changing business priorities.

- Monitor utilisation and ensure adherence to approved budgets.

- Maintain appropriate governance over campaign spends, approvals and reporting.

- Continuously identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of media investment.

- Outcome: Disciplined allocation of digital media investment with demonstrable improvements in effectiveness and efficiency.

F. Agency and Partner Management:

- Develop clear agency briefs linked to marketing and business objectives.

- Evaluate media recommendations, audience strategies and campaign plans.

- Challenge agency recommendations where required and independently assess opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on time and within approved budgets.

- Establish structured agency performance reviews.

- Hold partners accountable for campaign delivery, optimisation, reporting and agreed outcomes.

- Outcome: High-quality agency output with strong accountability for performance and execution.

G. Measurement, Analytics and Optimisation:

- Establish campaign dashboards and regular performance reviews.

- Monitor metrics including reach, frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL/CPA, conversion rates and downstream business conversion.

- Analyse performance across channels, campaigns, audiences, creatives and propositions.

- Conduct structured experiments across media strategies, audiences, formats and creative executions.

- Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and actions.

- Build learnings from completed campaigns into future media planning.

- Outcome: Continuous improvement in digital media performance supported by robust measurement and experimentation.

H. Media Team Leadership:

- Lead two manager-level reportees and one Media Analyst, with clear ownership of campaigns, channel plans, analytics and deliverables.

- Translate media objectives into team priorities, allocate work and set individual goals aligned to brand, acquisition and business outcomes.

- Personally lead priority media plans, critical campaigns, strategic partner discussions and complex performance interventions.

- Review and guide the manager's media plans, campaign execution, optimisation and agency coordination; remain accountable for delivery quality and results.

- Guide the Media Analyst on reporting, funnel measurement, performance diagnosis and experiments, ensuring insights lead to action.

- Run regular team performance reviews, coach reportees, build capabilities and manage individual performance.

- Outcome: A capable, accountable external media team delivering agreed outcomes, supported by hands-on leadership on priority work.

Experience and Qualifications:

Experience:

- 7 - 10 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, media planning or performance marketing.

- Demonstrated experience managing paid digital campaigns across major digital platforms.

- Experience spanning both brand-led digital media and performance/customer-acquisition marketing.

- Experience managing digital media agencies and evaluating media recommendations independently.

- Strong understanding of digital media planning, audience strategy, campaign optimisation and measurement.

- Experience working with customer acquisition funnels and downstream conversion metrics.

- Demonstrated experience leading media or performance marketing teams, including setting goals, delegating work, coaching and reviewing performance, while retaining hands-on campaign and planning responsibilities.

- Exposure to BFSI, fintech, consumer internet, telecom, e-commerce or other high-volume consumer businesses preferred.

Education:

- MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business or a related discipline preferred.

title: Business Director, People Analytics
description:
Business Director, People Analytics

As a Director, Business Analysis at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to one of the company's most important challenges: how our workforce evolves in the age of AI. You will lead a team with world-class professionals to develop, test, and scale strategies that shape how Capital One attracts, develops, and retains talent. And you'll do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.


Team and Position details:

People Strategy & Analytics is an emerging field where Capital One is on the leading front. Our team pairs data and analytics with enterprise-wide projects to help Capital One transform its workforce for the AI revolution. We work closely with HR partners and senior executives to shape talent strategy, translate insights into action, and build the tools, playbooks, and forums that help leaders across the company make better talent decisions as AI continues to transform how we work.

You will lead a team of analysts and apply your strategic and analytical skills to solve open-ended, complex questions about how we attract, develop, and retain top talent in a rapidly changing environment. You will also coordinate enterprise initiatives that turn insights into action, partnering with world-class professionals and senior leaders across HR and the business. Your day-to-day might involve:

  • Developing analyses and tools that help business leaders build a future-ready, AI-enabled workforce
  • Building models to predict attrition, and testing new retention strategies
  • Analyzing how AI is reshaping roles, and testing new hiring, retention, and talent development strategies
  • Designing new ways to understand and measure associate potential
  • Leading cross-functional initiatives and partnering with lines of business to drive a consistent AI workforce strategy

General Responsibilities:

  • Workforce strategy: Drive the enterprise strategy for building an AI-ready workforce, assessing how AI reshapes roles and evolving Capital One's hiring, reskilling, and org-design response to attract, develop, and retain talent.
  • Program leadership: Design and scale the resources and governance forums that help enterprise leaders transform with AI and plan their AI-forward talent strategy.
  • People analytics: Build analyses, models, and tools across attrition, retention, internal mobility, and sentiment that turn people data into executive-level talent decisions.
  • End-to-end ownership: Independently own complex, open-ended workforce problems by framing the problem, driving the analysis, and delivering recommendations that inform executive-level talent decisions.
  • Baseline AI fluency: Leverage enterprise AI tools to accelerate analysis, delivery, and program execution
  • Cross-enterprise partnership: Build enduring and productive relationships across HR and the lines of business to sequence and deliver multiple priorities
  • People leadership: Manage and develop a team of analysts; coach and mentor associates across the organization to develop and retain top talent at Capital One
  • Strategic and analytic orientation: Bring proven problem-solving and decision-making grounded in analytics, pairing conceptual thinking with a strong quantitative orientation.
  • Executive communication: Communicate with impeccable written and oral skills and strategic influence, driving agreement through intellect, storytelling with data, and negotiation.
  • Strong business judgment, leadership, and integrity: Be tenacious in driving decisions, and bring a healthy, aggressive yet responsible approach to solving complex, ambiguous problems
  • Clear results orientation: Demonstrate an intense focus on achieving short- and long-term goals, and the ability to drive an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment. Track record of thriving in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and dynamic environment; previous consulting experience is a plus

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • At least 4 years of experience performing quantitative analysis
  • At least 4 years of experience performing qualitative analysis
  • At least 2 years of experience performing people management
  • At least 2 years of experience performing project management


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree
  • 2+ years of experience in financial services
  • 1+ year of experience in consulting

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

description:
You'll lead the day-to-day and long-term performance of maintenance, property watch, and marina infrastructure operations across the resort.   • Oversee daily operations of the Maintenance Department, including property watch and dockside marina operations.

title: Orthodontic Assistant at Sutton Children's Dentistry & Orthodontics
description:
Rhode Island Children’s Dentistry & Orthodontics is seeking a friendly, skilled, and patient-focused Orthodontic Assistant to join our team. Website: Rhode Island Children’s Dentistry & Orthodontics

  • Clean, disinfect, and prepare operatories between patients

  • Maintain and organize orthodontic instruments, equipment, and supplies

  • Experience working with children and families preferred

  • Familiarity with orthodontic terminology, instruments, and procedures

title: Software Engineer III, Software Services (Applications)
location: Hybrid- Any Office (Fremont, CA, Salem, OR, or Pittsburgh, PA)
description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About Agility Robotics

Agility Robotics builds Digit — the first humanoid robot doing real, paid work in warehouses and distribution centers today. Our mission is to build robot partners that augment the human workforce, and Digit is already working alongside people at real customer sites through our Agility Partner Program. Humanoid robotics is one of the most closely watched spaces in tech right now, and very few engineering teams get to write the software that commands and manages a fleet of humanoid robots operating in the real world.

About the Team

You'll join the Software Services (backend) team, part of the broader Applications & Platform Software Engineering organization building Arc — our cloud application for robot fleet management, robot operations, and fleet data collection. The team spans Senior Staff to SWE III, so you'll have direct access to experienced engineers as you ramp up: you'll get an assigned mentor for your first 90 days, and after that you'll work closely with whichever senior or staff engineer is leading your project.

What You'll Do

  • Build backend APIs and services for Arc, our cloud-based robot fleet management platform.
  • Own well-scoped features end-to-end, and contribute to larger ones alongside senior engineers.
  • Turn product requirements into technical designs — write design docs, build proof-of-concepts, and ship code.

title: Senior Manager - AI Engineering
description:

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team.

- 6+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang.

- 3+ years of experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Provide support to the EPMO through the initiation and delivery of key projects focusing on the management and tracking of issues/risks, reporting on the health of all elements of the project plan, and support the development of project artifacts. The incumbent will report to the EPMO Portfolio Governance Manager and work alongside the Project Manager to support day-to-day project delivery.


As a Member of Our Team You Will be Responsible For:

  • Manage project resource capacity plans

  • Manage the risk process including identification and documentation of potential risks, development of mitigation strategies & contingency plans, reporting / visibility on all risks, and tracking / escalating risks to resolution
  • Collaborate with other project management resources to align and monitor interdependencies across various projects
  • Review, analyze, and document the impact of issues and apply measures to resolve them while escalating major issues within the governance framework
  • Report to key stakeholders, as planned or as needed, on the health of all elements of the project plan in adherence to EPMO reporting guidelines
  • Assist in the preparation of clear and effective communications to the project team and stakeholders with respect to status, related changes, and implementations

  • Work collaboratively with teams across IMCO and our vendor partners

What do you need to succeed?


  • Comprehensive knowledge of project principles, practices and methodologies, with the ability to recommend tools and templates
  • Adhere to IMCO Project Guidelines, including IMCO Project Framework (IPF) requirements
  • Can effectively present and consolidate project status reports for various management levels
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrable experience actively building relationships across teams
  • Ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data
  • Employ a spirit of 'get it done together', sharing practices and ideas
  • Demonstrable experience in learning from both success and failure
  • Responds well to ambiguity and works efficiently to clarify situations and outcomes
  • Good problem-solving and innovative thinking skills, must be able to articulate solutions, ideas, and recommendations through effective issue resolution
  • Experience supporting the PPM administration, including user setup, security settings, and project space configuration. Ability to contribute to the solution design for the PPM platform (e.g., custom workflows, dashboards, request forms)
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of EPMO governance standards, templates, tools and reporting practices.
  • Support project and portfolio governance forums by coordinating inputs and materials, documenting key decisions and actions, and tracking follow-ups and escalations.
  • Provide portfolio reporting support by preparing and consolidating status, financial, timeline and risk/issue information for EPMO and leadership reviews.
  • Support EPMO governance by running health checks on in-flight projects against the IPF and following up on findings.

‎

title: Sr IT Business Analyst
location: South Florida Community Care Network, LLC, Sunrise, FL, US
description:
Position Summary:

The Senior IT Business Analyst is a senior-level individual contributor responsible for independently leading complex business analysis activities for high-impact, cross-functional technology initiatives and operational enhancements. This position determines appropriate analysis approaches, facilitates resolution of ambiguous or conflicting requirements, evaluates business processes and solution alternatives, and provides recommendations to business and IT leadership. The Senior IT Business Analyst is accountable for the completeness, quality, and traceability of assigned business analysis deliverables and provides functional leadership, peer review, and mentoring to IT Business Analysts. The position partners with IT Project Managers throughout delivery and reports to the Manager, IT PMO, without formal people-management responsibility.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of progressive experience in IT business analysis, requirements management, business process improvement, and technology implementation, including demonstrated responsibility for complex cross-functional initiatives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. Provide functional leadership, peer review, and mentoring to IT Business Analysts; guide the application of established business analysis methodologies and elevate the quality and consistency of team deliverables without formal supervisory responsibility.
  2. Independently establish and lead the business analysis approach and workstream for complex or high-impact initiatives; partner with the IT Project Manager to align analysis milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables with the approved project plan.
  3. Lead complex discovery and requirements workshops involving multiple business and IT stakeholders; reconcile competing needs and develop validated functional and nonfunctional requirements, current-state and future-state workflows, and acceptance criteria.
  4. Lead requirements validation and traceability throughout solution design, development, and testing; coordinate business analysis inputs to user acceptance testing, defect triage, business readiness, and post-implementation validation.
  5. Lead complex feasibility, gap, root-cause, impact, and process-improvement assessments; evaluate solution options, tradeoffs, enterprise impacts, and operational risks, and present actionable recommendations to leadership.
  6. Own the completeness, accuracy, and traceability of assigned complex business analysis deliverables, including requirements, process flows, functional specifications, user stories or use cases, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and decision documentation.
  7. Ensure business analysis work complies with organizational standards, applicable healthcare regulations, privacy and information-security requirements, and established IT PMO governance practices; proactively identify and escalate compliance-related risks.
  8. Lead assessments of complex ServiceNow enhancement requests, partnering with requestors and technical owners to evaluate business value, urgency, complexity, dependencies, resource considerations, and delivery risks; recommend operational handling or formal project intake to the Manager, IT PMO.
  9. Facilitate cross-functional discussions to resolve ambiguous requirements and competing stakeholder priorities; present decision options, business impacts, risks, and recommendations to IT leadership and senior business stakeholders.
  10. Demonstrate a high degree of initiative, accountability, and independent judgment by proactively anticipating business needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Effectively manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing priorities, consistently deliver quality results with minimal supervision, and proactively seek opportunities to contribute to broader departmental objectives.
  11. Proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of IT PMO business analysis practices, processes, and standards. Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to IT Business Analysts, identify opportunities to improve team efficiency and deliverable quality, and support the implementation of improvements in alignment with standards established by the Manager, IT PMO.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their supervisor or management.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated functional leadership and ability to influence stakeholders, mentor colleagues, provide constructive feedback and peer review, and contribute to team effectiveness without formal supervisory authority.
  • Advanced knowledge of requirements elicitation, validation, traceability, business process modeling, and predictive, iterative, Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery approaches; familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, ClickUp, or Jira.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with contemporary system development processes, user acceptance testing, solution evaluation, business readiness, and implementation support.
  • Proficiency in business process mapping and data analysis tools such as Excel, Visio, SQL, or Power BI; ability to translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to resolve competing requirements, influence decisions, and communicate complex findings to senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated initiative and accountability, with the ability to proactively identify business needs, anticipate next steps, take ownership of responsibilities, and consistently deliver quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent initiatives, balance competing priorities, meet deadlines, and proactively seek additional responsibilities when capacity allows.
  • Advanced critical thinking, independent problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate alternatives, exercise sound judgment, and recommend solutions without requiring routine management direction.

Work Schedule:

Community Care Plan is currently following a hybrid work schedule. The company reserves the right to change the work schedules based on the company needs.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit. The employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job. description:

The Refi Tech team at Capital One is dedicated to simplifying the auto refinance process, helping customers seamlessly replace their current auto loans with options that better suit their financial needs. We focus on building and optimizing the end to end digital experience of the Auto Refi App, specifically bridging the gap between pre qualification and agent funding. By developing intuitive interfaces for checking savings, selecting offers, and completing applications, the team ensures a highly convenient, user-friendly platform that empowers customers to manage their refinancing journey whenever and wherever they choose. title: Platform Engineer - CI/CD Pipeline
description:
Profile: Platform Engineer

About SolarSquare:

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

What Platform is here to do:

Platform builds the systems every other team depends on and makes them simple to use. In practice that means:

- Designing systems and the contracts between them so teams can work together without knowing each other's internals.

- Hiding complexity behind clean interfaces: one way to authenticate, publish an event, schedule work or call a vendor, instead of five.

- Treating cost as a design requirement. A service should be cheaper to run next quarter than it is today.

- Keeping the architecture small enough for one person to understand and able to scale without a rewrite.

- Defining the guardrails, templates and standards that engineers and coding agents both build within.

What you'll do:

- Write TRDs precise enough for an agent to execute and clear enough for a new engineer to review, then drive them to production, checking and correcting what the agents produce.

- Build and run shared backend services such as authentication, event streaming, scheduling and deep linking, and the integrations that connect them.

- Find the same problem being solved in three places and replace it with one service, library or guardrail.

- Make the infrastructure calls for what you own (data stores, queues, caching, scaling, failure handling) and write down the trade-offs.

- Turn what works into org-wide practice: reusable skills, agent instructions, review checklists and sessions that bring other pods along.

- Question decisions, including leadership's, when the evidence points to a better way.

You'll fit if:

- You have 3 - 6 years building backend systems in production, with strong fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, networking, and how databases and queues behave under load.

- You think in systems and interfaces. You can explain why a boundary sits where it does, and you notice when an abstraction has started costing more than it saves.

- You work hands-on with AI coding agents every day and have opinions, backed by experience, on where they help, where they fail and how to constrain them.

- You write well. Your design docs remove ambiguity instead of moving it somewhere else.

- You can't leave a known problem alone, and you insist on doing things the right way. When you find a better practice, you make sure the rest of the org adopts it, not only your team.

- You move fast because your designs are clear, not because you skip steps. You would rather cut scope than ship something you will need to apologise for.

- You know containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure well enough to deploy and debug your own services without waiting on anyone.

- You judge your work by what it changed for the people using it: cost saved, hours removed, incidents that stopped recurring.

The tech you'll work with :

- AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Kafka, Redis, and Datadog, Prometheus and Grafana for observability, alongside coding agents and internal tooling built on top of them.

title: Performance Engineer (6391)
description:
itD is seeking a Performance Engineer to optimize the speed, scalability, stability, and reliability of enterprise digital platforms and cloud-native applications. This role will focus on designing and executing performance tests, automating performance validation, monitoring system health, and identifying opportunities to improve application performance and resilience. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in performance engineering, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and observability tools, with a proven track record of supporting high-traffic applications and resolving complex performance bottlenecks.

Location: Nearshore - Remote

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more. Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute performance engineering activities across digital platforms, e-commerce applications, microservices, and APIs to ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability.
  • Design, develop, script, and execute performance tests, including load, stress, spike, and soak testing, to evaluate system behavior against established benchmarks and KPIs.
  • Perform capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, and performance assessments to identify system limitations and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Support Chaos Engineering initiatives by using tools such as Gremlin, Chaos Mesh, or similar platforms to simulate failure scenarios and validate system resilience and recovery capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting dashboards using observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or equivalent platforms.
  • Integrate automated performance testing, regression checks, and performance gates into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous performance validation.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis of performance incidents, document test plans and findings, recommend corrective actions, and communicate results to Development, SRE, DevOps, Cloud, Architecture, and Product teams.

Internal Responsibilities:

  • Attend regular internal practice community meetings.
  • Collaborate with your itD practice team on industry thought leadership.
  • Complete client case studies and learning material (blogs, media material).
  • Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
  • Attend internal itD networking events (in person and virtual).
  • Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in performance engineering, scalability testing, and performance optimization of large-scale, high-traffic systems.
  • 4+ years of experience supporting the stability, reliability, and performance of mission-critical software applications in production environments.
  • 4+ years of experience with monitoring, observability, and performance management tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
  • Proficiency with performance testing tools such as JMeter, BlazeMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic.
  • Strong programming and scripting skills using Java, Python, and/or Groovy.
  • Experience troubleshooting distributed systems through log analysis, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and performance bottleneck identification.
  • Experience working with microservices, APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Ability to collaborate with Development, DevOps, SRE, Cloud, and Architecture teams to support performance and reliability initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in retail, e-commerce, or another high-scale digital environment.
  • Experience with Chaos Engineering tools such as Gremlin and Chaos Mesh.
  • Experience integrating automated performance testing and performance gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting capacity planning and resilience testing for large-scale distributed applications.
  • Familiarity with post-incident performance analysis and implementing preventive system improvements.

Education

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience required.

About itD: We are part of a new generation of consulting and software development company that blends diversity, innovation, and integrity with real business results. title: RCM Payment Resolution & Correspondence Specialist
description:
RCM Payment Resolution & Correspondence Specialist
Job Summary:
The RCM – Payment Resolution & Correspondence is responsible for the daily management of the AthenaOne Unpostable Dashboard and Correspondence Dashboard. This position ensures timely research and resolution of unapplied payments, payer correspondence, and documentation requests to optimize cash flow, reduce accounts receivable, and support timely claim adjudication.
The specialist serves as the subject matter expert for payment exception management and correspondence workflows, partnering with Payment Posting, Billing, Denials, Finance, Managed Care, and Practice Operations to resolve payment discrepancies and payer inquiries. This role is instrumental in maintaining the integrity of the revenue cycle by minimizing unapplied cash, reducing correspondence backlogs, and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
.
Primary Job Responsibilities:
  • Manage the AthenaOne Unpostable Dashboard daily to research and resolve unapplied insurance and patient payments.
  • Manage the AthenaOne Correspondence Dashboard to ensure timely processing of payer requests and claim-related correspondence.
  • Research payment discrepancies using ERAs, EOBs, EFTs, clearinghouse reports, bank deposits, payer portals, and AthenaOne.
  • Apply, transfer, reverse, or adjust payments as appropriate to ensure accurate account reconciliation.
  • Partner with internal departments and insurance carriers to resolve payment exceptions and correspondence issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all research and resolution activities within AthenaOne.
  • Monitor work queue aging and prioritize accounts to meet organizational turnaround standards and payer filing deadlines.
  • Identify recurring trends contributing to unapplied payments or correspondence delays and recommend process improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS regulations, payer requirements, and organizational policies.

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required; associate’s degree in healthcare administration, Business, Accounting, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of healthcare Revenue Cycle experience, with emphasis in payment posting, accounts receivable, billing, denials, or cash management.
  • Experience working within an electronic practice management system; AthenaOne experience strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of medical billing, insurance claims processing, and payment posting workflows.
  • Experience researching and resolving insurance payment discrepancies.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience managing AthenaOne Unpostable and/or Correspondence Dashboards.
  • Knowledge of ERA/EFT processing and electronic payment reconciliation.• Experience with commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payer guidelines.
  • Experience utilizing payer portals and clearinghouse systems.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  • Strong analytical and investigative problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple work queues.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement methodologies and insurance payment processes.
  • Ability to interpret Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), Electronic Remittance Advice (ERAs), and payer correspondence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail with strong accuracy in payment application and documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Billing, Payment Posting, Denials, Patient Financial Services, Practice Operations, and external payers.
  • Ability to identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while meeting productivity and quality expectations.

title: Transitional Living House Manger - Sober Recovery
description:
Since 2020, dWELL has been an affirming recovery housing program on a mission to support young adults in their transition to independence through residences and a community-based approach that supports growth and healing. We provide a personalized, foundational, skills-based model that helps young adults pursue their individual life goals. We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented, and innovative House Manager for our Transitional Living Program (TLP) to join our New York City team and contribute to our goal of making a difference.

We're seeking an experienced and compassionate Transitional Living House Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate has a background in behavioral health, mental health, substance use recovery, or supportive housing and is passionate about helping young adults build greater independence. In this role, you'll provide individualized resident support, coordinate care, guide residential staff, and oversee daily programming that promotes long-term stability and recovery.

dWELL Recovery is seeking a dedicated and compassionate House Manager to work the following shift:

  • Tuesday through Saturday from 1 PM - 9 PM

What You Will Do:

  • Provide individualized case management and resident support through goal setting, progress monitoring, life skills coaching, and transition planning to promote recovery and independence
  • Oversee daily transitional living programming, including resident routines, activities of daily living (ADLs), household responsibilities, and community engagement
  • Collaborate with clinical providers and treatment teams to coordinate resident care, align support with treatment and recovery goals, and respond to emerging needs or crises
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for families, providing regular updates, facilitating communication, and supporting family involvement in the recovery process
  • Provide supervision, training, and ongoing guidance to residential team members, ensuring consistent resident support, documentation, and adherence to program expectations
  • Facilitate community activities, recovery-focused engagement, and weekend programming while supporting additional services, including studio and companion support
  • Maintain accurate and timely resident documentation, including progress notes, shift reports, daily plans, medication support records, and apartment checklists
  • Oversee daily program coordination, apartment inspections, move-in preparations, and inventory management to ensure safe, organized, and supportive residential environments
  • Lead assigned program improvement projects and participate in team meetings, supervision, and professional development initiatives

What You Need to Qualify:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in psychology, social work, counseling, human services, or a related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in behavioral health, mental health, substance use treatment, residential programming, or a related field
  • Experience providing case management, life skills coaching, or direct support to individuals with mental health or substance use challenges
  • Familiarity with trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, recovery-oriented approaches, and family systems
  • Strong communication, organizational, and documentation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate sensitive situations
  • Ability to build supportive relationships with residents while maintaining professional boundaries, accountability, and program expectations
  • CPR and First Aid certification, or willingness to obtain certification

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift 20–40 lbs occasionally
  • Ability to stand, walk, or respond quickly during emergencies
  • Ability to walk multiple levels of stairs multiple times daily
  • Must be able to complete facility rounds and inspections

What We Offer:

  • Full benefits including comprehensive medical, dental, vision and a 401K with up to 3% company match, fully vested after 3 years
  • Flexible PTO - for a team that’s rested, recharged and feeling their best
  • Hands-on, creative, team-based work environment in the heart of New York City
  • We are family-owned and operated, offering a close-knit culture that emphasizes teamwork, trust, and a personal connection with every member of our team
  • 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave following a full year of service - providing support and flexibility during life’s most important moments


Schedule: Tuesday through Saturday from 1PM - 9PM

title: Finance Business Process Specialist
description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We believe AI will fundamentally change how Finance organizations operate. Our goal is to rethink how work gets done - reducing administrative complexity, automating repetitive activities, connecting fragmented information, and enabling our people to focus on higher-value business decisions.

This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara,CA or Austin,TX.

Who You Are

  • You are an analytical, process-oriented problem solver who challenges the status quo and looks for ways to eliminate complexity, not just document it.

  • You understand core finance processes such as Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and financial planning and reporting, and have experience with process mapping, requirements, and gap assessments.
  • You are comfortable with ERPs and integrated business applications, and actively explore AI, automation, workflow tools, and analytics to solve practical business problems.

What We Need

  • Partner across Controlling, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Accounting Operations, Finance Systems, Supply Chain, and Sales Operations to discover workflows, dependencies, ownership gaps, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Turn fragmented information into clear process maps, functional requirements, actionable roadmaps, and a searchable knowledge base for procedures, decisions, and design documents.
  • Redesign processes with AI and automation in mind, identifying work to eliminate, simplify, automate, or augment while maintaining financial integrity, internal controls, compliance, and auditability.
  • Prototype and evaluate AI-enabled solutions, then partner with Finance Systems and IT to integrate successful approaches into supported workflows. Establish testing, human review, exception handling, monitoring, and audit trails, and measure impact through quality, accuracy, time saved, adoption, and business value.

What You Will Learn

  • Understand how financial processes evolve as a technology company moves from development-focused operations to global commercialization.
  • Gain exposure to modern enterprise finance systems and the connections between Finance and operational teams.
  • Build experience identifying and implementing AI-enabled workflows, low-code/no-code automation, and process orchestration.
  • Strengthen your skills in business analysis, project execution, change management, stakeholder engagement, and communicating measurable business outcomes.

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. title: Chief Investment & Asset Management Officer - Hospitality Business
description:
Role Overview:

We are searching for a Chief Investment and Asset Management Officer for a hospitality business based in Mumbai that is a part of a leading multinational conglomerate.

Key Responsibility:

1. Global business development and portfolio expansion:

- Build and convert a disciplined pipeline of acquisitions, greenfield and brownfield developments, strategic investments, management platforms and new-market opportunities.

- Assess market demand, competitive positioning, brand fit and strategic value.

- Originate opportunities through owners, developers, advisers and investors, and present prioritized recommendations to the Managing Director and Boards.

2. Investment evaluation and commercial diligence:

- Lead feasibility studies, valuation, financial modelling, scenario analysis and commercial assessment of new and existing businesses.

- Test investment assumptions, capital requirements, cash generation, return on investment and internal rate of return.

- Coordinate financial, operational, legal, tax and technical diligence with the CFO and advisers; identify downside risks and recommend investment structures, pricing and conditions that protect ownership economics.

3. Transactions and Hotel agreements:

- Lead acquisition and investment negotiations, including debt, equity and joint venture structures, with sellers, coinvestors, family offices, institutional partners and lenders.

- Negotiate management, franchise, lease, shareholder and related hotel agreements with legal support. Address fees, performance tests, owner rights, funding obligations, reserved matters, exit provisions and remedies.

- Secure approvals, manage closing conditions and coordinate funding execution with the CFO.

4. International asset management and operating performance:

- Lead assigned regional owner teams and hold operators and property leaders accountable through agreed governance.

- Review business plans, budgets, forecasts and results against the investment case and market benchmarks.

- Drive revenue, productivity, guest experience, profitability and cash conversion.

- Track occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOPPAR, EBITDA, NOI and investment returns, as relevant; resolve underperformance through regular reviews and accountable action plans.

5. Asset enhancement and Capital deployment:

- Lead value-enhancement plans covering repositioning, brand or operator changes, refurbishment, cost restructuring, refinancing and selective divestment.

- Evaluate capital expenditure against expected benefits, returns and funding capacity with the CFO.

- Monitor approved budgets, delivery milestones and realized outcomes.

- Oversee post-acquisition integration or mobilization, ensuring operating assumptions, synergies and investment commitments translate into results with the relevant regional business owner.

6. Operator partnerships and Ownership governance:

- Represent the company in assigned boards, owner committees and strategic forums.

- Align operators, brands and joint venture partners on strategy, budgets, key appointments, service and brand standards, capital requirements and performance obligations.

- Translate agreements into measurable KPIs and review routines.

- Resolve escalated commercial or contractual issues; maintain records of decisions, commitments and corrective actions within approved authority, funding and reporting frameworks.

7. Compliance and Portfolio risk:

- Own commercial and contractual compliance for transactions and assigned international assets, working with legal, local management and the CFO on regulatory requirements, licences, approvals and obligations.

- Identify investment, counterparty, operating and geopolitical risks, with named mitigation owners.

- Coordinate financial, foreign exchange, interest-rate, insurance, tax and audit exposures with the CFO.

- Apply delegated authority, transparent conduct and timely escalation of material issues.

Skills & Qualification:

- Chartered Accountant or MBA, preferably in Finance, Strategy or a related discipline, with minimum 18 years experience in hospitality investments, business development, mergers and acquisitions or owner-side asset management.

- Demonstrated success in originating, evaluating, negotiating and closing investments, followed by improving asset performance and returns across international markets.

- Strong command of hotel agreements, commercial diligence, valuation, capital structures and investor negotiations, with the ability to challenge operators and manage advisers.

- Sound commercial judgment, negotiation skills and board-level communication; able to lead across cultures, protect ownership interests and travel extensively.
